jobs.title: Marketing Program Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.We're looking for a Marketing Program Manager to join our Partner Marketing team and help us execute co\-marketing programs, events, and industry marketing with top game developers and technology partners. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, marketing, and program management, and plays an important part in supporting partner relationships and program delivery across our platform. Reporting to the Director, Partner Marketing, you'll work cross\-functionally to help ensure the successful launch of win\-win\-win campaigns: good for players, good for partners, and good for our business. You'll help keep timelines, processes, and cross\-functional coordination on track across sales, product, brand, creative, and channel teams. What You'll Be Doing Co\-Marketing Execution Support and execute partner co\-marketing campaigns across channels including owned social, email, in\-product placements, and live events. Help maintain marketing "playbooks" and repeatable program templates that support consistency and faster time\-to\-launch across partners. Support GTM planning for partner moments (new product launches, integrations, tentpole game releases), helping prepare materials and recommendations for review. Coordinate with partners' marketing counterparts on creative direction, promotional timing, approvals, and campaign deliverables. Cross\-Functional Program Coordination Provide day\-to\-day program support for Commerce partners, helping keep always\-on promotions running smoothly. Coordinate with Developer Solutions, Advertising, Commerce, PMM, and Channel Marketing teams to track timelines, deliverables, and responsibilities for partner\-facing programs. Maintain project timelines, flag dependencies and risks, and help facilitate regular syncs with internal stakeholders. Maintain intake and request\-tracking workflows (e.g., via Salesforce and Asana) so partner marketing requests are logged, prioritized, and actioned consistently. Support the development of B2B marketing collateral and presentations in partnership with Product Marketing and Consumer Marketing teams (newsletters, blog posts, case study amplification). Help coordinate partner workshops, innovation days, QBR presentations, and industry summits, using established frameworks and templates. Reporting \& Optimization Track campaign performance against business KPIs — including revenue supported, daily account linked players (DALP), and Commerce GMV — and help synthesize insights for the team. Help maintain a partner marketing roadmap that shows program activity and status for cross\-functional visibility. Flag recurring friction points (e.g., one\-off approval requests, low\-priority asks) to help the team improve processes over time. What you should have Experience 5–6 years of experience in partner marketing, co\-marketing, marketing operations, or program/project coordination — ideally in a tech, gaming, or platform company. Experience supporting cross\-functional marketing programs, from intake through launch and reporting. Some experience working directly with external partners or clients in a marketing capacity. Skills Solid project management instincts: comfortable tracking timelines, managing dependencies across multiple stakeholders, and flagging risks. Strong written and verbal communicator, able to organize information clearly for review by others. Detail\-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage an asset tracker or partner approval request end\-to\-end. Comfortable working in fast\-paced environments with shifting priorities. Good analytical instincts — comfortable pulling data and connecting program activity to business metrics with guidance. Tools Proficiency in project management and workflow tools (e.g., Asana, Salesforce, Notion, Google Workspace, Claude / AI). Familiarity with cross\-functional marketing operations, including intake and approval workflows. Experience with presentation\-heavy environments (Google Slides / PowerPoint) — you'll frequently build and review partner\-facing materials. Bonus Points Experience in the gaming industry or with game developer partnerships. Background in or exposure to developer marketing, platform marketing, or B2B marketing. Familiarity with co\-marketing in a deal context — where marketing is part of a larger commercial negotiation. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $148,000 to $166,500 \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.Why Discord?Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know. jobs.title: CAP-CT Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Function Summary**

Involves analytical studies on a variety of policies, projects, programs and issues in support of a function, research initiative, program and / or organizational unit, or in research of new or changing systems and programs. Assists in policy and program planning, development, administration, management and implementation; interprets, monitors and analyzes information regarding policies and procedures and provides consultative services to department administrators and other stakeholders.


**Generic Scope**

Professional who applies acquired job skills, policies, and procedures to complete substantive assignments / projects / tasks of moderate scope and complexity; exercises judgment within defined guidelines and practices to determine appropriate action.


**Custom Scope**

The UCSF Division of Geriatrics seeks to recruit a full\-time **Program Coordinator** to support the implementation and operational ownership of a Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) funded program, Caregivers as Partners in Care Teams (CAP\-CT). This position reports to the Program Director and supports/leads a wide\-range of project operations and coordination tasks. The Program Coordinator will perform a broad range of duties that will require analytical, organizational, communication, technical, and coordination skills. Specific duties include: coordinating and maintaining project timelines and deliverables, assisting with researching and applying relevant policies, data collection, management, analyses and reporting, preparing and updating program materials/protocols/procedures, coordinating meeting schedules/agendas/minutes, drafting and updating documents, making program\-related purchases and submitting expense reports, conducting literature searches/reviews, and supporting manuscript preparation/scholarly dissemination. The Program Coordinator will additionally function as a subject matter expert and provide oversight and direction on learning management systems, manage digital education platforms, CE/CME accreditation coordination, analytics reporting, marketing communications, website management, and operational support across multiple projects and conferences. This position requires the ability to be proactive, resourceful and efficient, with a high level of flexibility. An ideal candidate will be able to work independently with minimal supervision, balances multiple competing priorities at any given time, and is intellectually curious, willing to learn new skills and a problem\-solver. The Program Coordinator may be required to provide the same level of support across projects/programs where there is a need.


**Department Overview**

The Division of Geriatrics’ work is grounded in a deep commitment to and respect for older persons from diverse backgrounds and lived experiences. We are specialists in aging. Our expertise is in optimizing the health of older individuals. We work in the community and on virtually every UCSF campus – Parnassus, San Francisco VA Health Care System, Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital, Mission Bay, and UCSF Center for Geriatric Care. The Division has over 130 employees including faculty, volunteer clinical faculty, fellows, staff, student interns and volunteers. We are deeply committed to, and will champion, diversity, equity and inclusion as our core mission. We will nurture and grow a culture in which everyone from all backgrounds is welcomed, supported, respected, and valued!


  
**Required Qualifications**

* At least 1 year of relevant experience.
* Working knowledge of common organization\- or research\-specific and other computer application programs.
* Proficient in communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
* Proficient in ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
* Demonstrates ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
* Demonstrates ability to analyze, research and synthesize large amounts of data with strong attention to detail.
* Proficient in ability to multi\-task with demanding timeframes.
* Experience in using Qualtrics/REDCap/other surveying platforms.
* Proficient in MS Suite (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, etc.)
* Proficient with Continuing Medical Education (CME) and Learning Management System (LMS).
* Experience working with consumers of educational courses/academic institutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in public health or research administration, e.g. working on state contracts, NIH programs, or working in an academic institution.
* Previous experience using project management tools and software, website management and managing social media platforms.

**Required Education**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.

jobs.title: Care Manager II
jobs.description:
IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status\-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.


With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well\-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.


The Care Manager II (CMII) is responsible for the assessment of clients with multiple medical and psychosocial needs. The CMII also plans for and monitors services and interventions ensuring provision of quality care.
RESPONSIBILITIES:* Conducts comprehensive assessments and on\-going re\-assessments of the client including psychosocial, physical and mental health, environmental and spiritual needs.
* Writes comprehensive assessments. Based on assessment information with the client develops and initiates the Community Living Plan, which is client\-centered, comprehensive and consistent with program guidelines and policies and procedures.
* Conducts home visits, acute hospital \& skilled nursing facility visits, as well as escorts clients to medical and other appointments as clinically indicated.
* Identifies, arranges for, and monitors appropriate community services based on a good knowledge of Medicare, Medi\-Cal, and other entitlement programs.
* Establishes and maintains a care management relationship with clients and their informal support network as appropriate, offering respect, dignity and support. Provides crisis intervention, advocacy, problem solving and therapeutic interventions.
* Meets with clients at least monthly, and more often as clinically indicated. Reviews and modifies their Community Living Plan on an ongoing basis.
* Documents via progress notes all case management activity regarding identified problems within 24\-48 hours, adding any new problems to the Community Living Plan, as needed.
* Maintains required paperwork and follows a clear, concise, and consistent system of charting to allow for continuity of care.
* Ongoing evaluation for client Purchase of Service needs and follow\-up to determine if services have been provided in a timely manner.
* Educates clients and informal support network about resources.
* Establishes and maintains open and effective communication with community providers, including physicians and other health care and social service workers. Provides appropriate information on all significant aspects of individual client care and program operations, while maintaining necessary confidentiality.
* Monitors the quantity and quality of the services provided by other involved providers.
* Working closely with the team, continuously evaluates the clients’ ability to remain safely at home, coordinates placement as appropriate, according to program guidelines.
* In collaboration with the client, caregiver, and involved services, terminates clients when appropriate. Documents the process as required.
* Participates in research studies and data collection, as required.
* Participates in and promotes ongoing efforts towards Continuous Quality Improvement.
* Attends and actively participates in team and program meetings, activities and problem\-solving endeavors; contributes to open lines of communication within the team.
* Utilizes supervision appropriately, maintaining open lines of communication and providing updates on caseload activity.
* Actively incorporates the ethical and legal standards of the National Association of Social Workers into all aspects of interactions with others.
* Understands and applies the regulatory and procedural requirements of the Institute on Aging.
* Attends continuing education classes and/or in\-service training to increase knowledge, skills and attitudes related to case management, gerontology, family and community systems and other areas relevant to the Community Living Fund client population.
* All other reasonably related responsibilities as assigned.

  

EDUCATION:

* M.S.W. (Masters in Social Work) or another appropriate Masters level degree such as an MPH, MFT with additional or specialized work experience such as psychology, counseling, or geriatrics.
* Alternatively, in lieu of a Masters degree, an employee may qualify for a Care Manager II position with a BA or BS in Social Work or another appropriate major and a minimum of two (2\) years of relevant social work experience and the ability to demonstrate autonomous work in conceptualizing and formulating biopsychosocial assessments, identifying care needs and necessary interventions, and then executing effective care interventions.


BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE:

jobs.title: Partner 20, Program Manager, Global Partnerships
jobs.description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth\-stage technology companies, across AI, bio \+ healthcare, consumer, crypto, enterprise, fintech, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B\+ under management across multiple funds.



We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company\-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. We’ve invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.


**The Role**
------------



We are looking for a Program Manager to drive execution across the Global Partnerships team. This role will manage roadshows and LP engagements, coordinate GP and LP availability, and lead projects that span the team. The ideal candidate brings structure to complex logistics, keeps stakeholders and priorities aligned, and ensures that commitments, deliverables, and follow\-ups move forward on time.



The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, anticipates needs before they are voiced, exercises sound judgment with highly sensitive information, and thrives in a fast\-moving, high\-stakes environment. You see around corners, sweat the details, and operate with a sense of ownership over outcomes, not just tasks.



We are open to candidates based in the San Francisco Bay Area. This role requires an in\-office presence and flexibility to support travel and time\-sensitive needs.


**What You’ll Do**
------------------


**Roadshows and GP/LP Engagement**


* Manage roadshows and LP events from planning through execution, including schedules, venues, accommodations, transportation, security, briefing materials, and day\-of logistics
* Coordinate GP and LP availability across multiple stakeholders, locations, and time zones, proactively resolving conflicts and schedule changes
* Drive the LP engagement cadence by maintaining the engagement calendar and CRM, tracking meetings and commitments, and ensuring timely follow\-up
* Coordinate and host LP experiences, ensuring each visit is polished, welcoming, and consistent with the a16z brand
* Drive LP\-related deliverables, including fundraising milestones, DDQs, and data\-room requests, by managing timelines, coordinating inputs, and guiding materials through review and approval across multiple stakeholders


**Team Programs and Projects**


* Drive cross\-team projects from kickoff through completion, establishing work plans, timelines, owners, and clear deliverables
* Lead working sessions, track decisions and action items, and keep contributors aligned and accountable
* Manage recurring team workflows, templates, and trackers, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and consistency
* Maintain visibility into team priorities, dependencies, and commitments, surfacing risks and conflicts before they affect execution
* Take on additional strategic and operational projects based on the team’s evolving priorities

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


* 5\-8\+ years in operations, program management, or supporting senior executives in a fast\-paced environment (e.g., venture capital, finance, professional services, or high\-growth tech), with meaningful exposure to complex logistics
* Proven track record managing complex multi\-city travel and high\-stakes external events from planning through flawless execution
* Exceptional organizational skills and obsessive attention to detail; able to manage many moving parts simultaneously without dropping a thread
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the polish and judgment to interface directly with LPs, senior leaders, and external partners
* Strong project management ability, with the range to take initiatives from 0 to 1, set timelines, and drive them to completion with minimal oversight
* Sound judgment and absolute discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information
* Comfort with ambiguity and a high rate of change; able to re\-prioritize quickly without compromising quality
* Proficiency with modern productivity, scheduling, and travel tools

**Ideal Candidate Background**
------------------------------


* You have a sense of urgency and value the courtesy of professional responsiveness (this is super important as speed is a form of client service)
* You anticipate needs and solve problems before they become problems; you see around corners
* You are able to adapt on the fly and handle unforeseen developments with ease, without compromising attention to detail and quality
* You strive to be an enabler who gives the leader and the team maximum leverage; there is no job too big, no job too small
* You do what you say you are going to do, when you say you are going to do it
* You continually search for new ideas and means of improvement
* You have low ego, high empathy, and the capacity to collaborate effectively
* Most importantly, you take your work seriously but not yourself too seriously


The anticipated salary range for this role is between $222,000 \- $259,000, actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope.



This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K plan, vacation, and sick leave.

**a16z culture**
----------------


* We do only first class business and only in a first class way
* We take a long view of relationships, because we are in the relationship business
* We believe in the future and bet the firm that way

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager, API
jobs.description:
Perplexity's API Platform brings our work in AI, search, and agent orchestration to developers. Our customers range from AI\-native startups to some of the world's largest technology companies. Working with them, alongside our own developments in building Perplexity’s core application gives our team direct exposure to how search, models, and tools are used to build and scale AI\-native products and applications.


**About this role**
-------------------


We are looking for a technically fluent Customer Success Manager to help our API customers succeed and shape how we support them as the business grows. You will own a portfolio of customers, understand what they are building, and help them move from evaluation to production and broader adoption.


Alongside your accounts, you will lead projects such as product and endpoint migrations, customer enablement, and communications for product updates and incidents. You will work directly with customers developing AI products and with the engineers building the APIs they depend on. As an early member of the team, you will help shape our customer success programs and bring what you learn from customers into product decisions.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Own customer relationships across onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion, building trust with developers, technical leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Understand each customer's use case, integration, and success criteria. Help them evaluate the APIs, resolve adoption barriers, and establish a path to production.
* Use account and product usage data to identify declining adoption, technical risks, and growth opportunities, then work with customers on specific next steps.
* Investigate technical questions using API documentation, sample requests, and usage data. Coordinate with Engineering and Support on deeper issues and keep customers informed through resolution.
* Lead customer\-facing programs such as endpoint migrations, product rollouts, and enablement. Define milestones, coordinate internal owners, and track customer readiness and completion.
* Manage customer communications for product changes, deprecations, and outages, partnering with technical teams to provide accurate updates and clear guidance.
* Build and improve the API customer success playbook, including onboarding, account reviews, customer health signals, escalation paths, and sales\-to\-CS handoffs.
* Partner with Sales and account owners on renewals and expansion, using adoption, consumption, and business outcomes to demonstrate value and surface risks early.
* Bring customer feedback into product planning and work with Developer Relations and Support on documentation and enablement that address recurring needs.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* 4\+ years of experience in customer success, technical account management, solutions engineering, or a related customer\-facing role at a technology company.
* Technical fluency: comfortable reading API documentation, making API requests, interpreting responses and errors, and discussing integration questions with developers.
* A track record of driving adoption, retention, or growth across a portfolio of customers, with clear ownership of follow\-through.
* Experience creating or improving a customer program, playbook, or cross\-functional process, not only operating an established one.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly and communicate carefully when facts are still developing.
* Sound judgment in balancing account needs with strategic projects, setting priorities, and moving work forward without a detailed brief.

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Experience with APIs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or usage\-based products.
* Familiarity with AI applications, search, retrieval, or agents, including how customers evaluate quality, latency, and cost.
* Working knowledge of Python or SQL for reproducing issues, analyzing usage, or automating recurring work.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**



AfterShip, a Great Place to Work Certified company, is transforming the global eCommerce landscape. Founded in 2012, AfterShip is a post\-purchase SaaS company on a mission to build the world's leading automation platform for ecommerce merchants.



AfterShip unifies shipping \& labels, order tracking, AI predictive delivery, and returns management into one system—giving merchants a single place to manage and automate everything that happens after checkout. By centralizing these workflows, AfterShip enables merchants to reduce customer support inquiries, deliver a more reliable and engaging customer experiences, and unlock incremental revenue at every post\-purchase touchpoint.



AfterShip integrates seamlessly with eCommerce platforms including Shopify and TikTok Shop, and connects with more than 1,400\+ carriers worldwide. Today, over 20,000 businesses—including Samsung, Gymshark, Mejuri, Dr. Squatch, and Alo Yoga—rely on AfterShip to turn every post\-purchase moment into an opportunity to build trust, reduce costs, and drive repeat purchases.



Built for a global market from day one, AfterShip operates with an engineering\-driven, internationally distributed team. The company employs more than 450 people across 8 offices, spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, and representing over 20 cities worldwide.


**Your Mission:**

* 3\+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Systems, ideally supporting both Sales and Customer Success.
* Hands\-on experience administering HubSpot and sales engagement/forecasting tools (Gong, Salesloft, Outreach, or similar), including owning a forecasting or pipeline reporting cadence end\-to\-end.
* Strong project management skills — a track record of driving cross\-functional work to completion, comfortable escalating blockers, with experience in Jira or a comparable ticketing system and a habit of proactive status updates.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — comfortable working directly with Sales, CS, Finance, Legal, and Partnerships stakeholders, and able to run and summarize cross\-functional meetings.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Associate Manager, DashMart - Supply Chain Profitability Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



Our New Verticals Strategy \& Operations team is re\-inventing the way consumers think about grocery, convenience, alcohol and retail delivery through both our first\-party and third\-party operations businesses. DashMarts are our first\-party offering designed to provide on\-demand deliveries by selling household essentials, groceries, brand\-name favorites, local favorites and so much more. The end to end DashMart experience is powered through DoorDash. Third\-party partnerships enable us to offer on\-demand deliveries from both SMB and enterprise merchants across grocery, convenience alcohol and retail storefronts. The merchants own the inventory, we fulfill and deliver them!


**About the Role**
------------------



We are hiring an Associate Manager to join the DashMart Strategy \& Operations organization, focused on reducing supply chain costs to fuel profitability. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end effort to reduce shrink, using SQL and AI to analyze data and identify opportunities, then designing and implementing solutions from the ground up. Solutions may be process\-driven, working closely with Ops, Supply Chain, Vendor Management, and Category, or product\-driven, partnering with Product and Engineering teams to build scalable fixes. You will be goaled directly against a key profitability metric, making this a highly visible role with outsized impact on the bottom line.



We're looking for someone with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills who can think outside the box to uncover non\-obvious opportunities and creative solutions. You should bring a high degree of ownership and be comfortable independently driving a project from data analysis through cross\-functional execution. This role sits at the intersection of operations, product, and finance, and is critical to DashMart's profitability goals.



You will report into a Manager within the DashMart team. We operate in a hybrid work model with opportunities for in\-person collaboration a few times a year, and all our offices are open should you choose to go in on a more regular basis! All employees that work on DashMart are also expected to spend time understanding the operation on site.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* **Strategize**. You'll set financial goals for Shrink in both the short and long term, and create the playbook to achieve those goals.
* **Analyze**. You'll assess financial opportunity and operational impacts of your decisions across the entire business, and iterate based on data.
* **Build**. You'll own the implementation of your strategies end to end, from documenting processes and requirements to measuring the success of the results.
* **Scale**. You'll transform analytical insights into operational experiments that create measurable and scalable improvements to profitability.
* **Lead and collaborate**. You'll influence a cross\-functional team including category management, vendor management, central operations, product, engineering, and finance to solve problems and scale solutions.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* **You have subject matter expertise in** process improvement, data modeling, supply chain, and strong financial and business acumen.
* **You're equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot.** You don't hesitate to get in the weeds with SQL and data analysis, but you're just as comfortable influencing roadmap discussions and strategic priorities.
* **You're unafraid of undefined processes.** You are a creative problem solver who's proficient at defining net new processes. You excel at working with a diverse group of people.
* **You're analytical.** You have a strong analytical background, advanced SQL proficiency, and experience with analytical visualization tooling (Sigma, Mode, Tableau, etc.). You have past experience building SQL queries from scratch and leveraging insights to drive business decisions.
* **You are AI native.** You think systematically about where AI can make your work better and have used AI tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini, etc. to enhance, refine and deepen your workflows.
* **You have 4\-6\+ years of experience.** You've succeeded at expanding businesses (whether in tech, retail, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience).
* You have completed your BS/BA Degree ideally in supply chain, business, economics, engineering or a related field.

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**Our Mission:** **Hospital\-Quality Care, Everywhere.**
========================================================


The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tags to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995\.


Verse Medical is building the modern software infrastructure to make it happen. We're a well\-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high\-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. We’re growing fast and looking for people who are driven by this mission to join us!

**Our Values:** **The Principles That Guide Us**
================================================


Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.

* **We are transparent, upfront and direct.** We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.
* **We value speed of iteration.** We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.
* **We give 110% effort, 30% of the time.** We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.
* **We empathize with customers to a fault.** When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, *"How can we make this better?"* We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real\-world challenges of healthcare.

**Your Impact: How You'll Help Us Heal a Broken System**
--------------------------------------------------------


This is a rare opportunity to join a small but mighty team in a broad, high\-ownership role. The S\&O team's work is both internal and externally focused. We untangle cross\-team coordination problems, design and own the operational processes that allow our company to scale, but also sometimes represent Verse externally when a partnership or deal calls for it.


You'll report to the Head of Strategy \& Operations and work closely with functional leaders across Partnerships, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and Product.

**What You'll Achieve: A Glimpse into Your Contributions**
----------------------------------------------------------


The specific initiative you're staffed on will shift over time, but your contributions will generally fall into a few recurring shapes of work:

* Cross\-functional coordination on high\-stakes, cross\-cutting initiatives: situations where multiple teams each own a piece of the puzzle and the work only succeeds if someone drives alignment and follow\-through across all of them (e.g., regulatory, compliance, or audit\-driven work)
* End\-to\-end program management for complex, high\-visibility deployments: running the project plan and owning the outcome, whether that's a major customer or partner implementation, or an initiative requiring close, sustained partnership with Engineering, Product, and Design
* Quantitative modeling and strategic analysis: building the financial or operational models that underpin major company decisions, from resourcing to strategic finance questions
* Revenue\-adjacent strategy and execution: go\-to\-market strategy in close partnership with Sales, and leading Verse's side of RFPs and similar competitive or procurement processes
* Incubating new functions from scratch: taking a "this doesn't exist yet, but we need it" problem and building the team, process, or capability that solves it, from initial design through steady\-state operation


This role comes with great responsibility \- we absolutely love what we do here at Verse and have a healthy culture, but you can expect this role and our expectations to be fairly rigorous.

**What You'll Bring: The Skills and Experience You'll Leverage**
----------------------------------------------------------------


We believe diverse backgrounds lead to better solutions. If you believe you can deliver the outcomes above, we encourage you to apply even if your path here looks different from what's listed.

### **Core Skills \& Experience**

* 4\+ years in a banking, consulting, startup, or otherwise rigorous role
* First\-principles thinking: in most cases, the work we're doing has fundamentally never been done before, at Verse or elsewhere. You should be able to construct solutions from scratch.
* Quantitative and analytical skills: all of our team members are expected to have solid numerical instincts and modeling skills
* Partnerships and sales: all of our team members should expect to carry the baton in some external relationship at some point, whether they're selling something to a customer, selecting and negotiating with vendors, or project managing a new partnership launch.
* Implementation and execution: the best team members not only produce insights, recommendations, strategies, but do whatever it takes to make sure these actually come to life. This usually requires a bias for quick action rather than slow and polished deliverables.
* Comfort with "spike" work: our workload isn't evenly paced — you flex your hours and effort to match real demand, surging when the team hits a crunch, a live issue, or a time\-sensitive push, and settling back into a sustainable pace once it passes

**The Rewards \& Reality: Compensation, Benefits \& Logistics**
-------------------------------------------------------

### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


Were a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


The Fluorescence Imaging Team at Intuitive is developing agents designed to work seamlessly with Intuitive’s robotic platforms and Firefly imaging technology. The agents have the potential to highlight critical anatomy and disease in real time—giving surgeons clearer information at the moment decisions matter most and helping improve outcomes for patients.


If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position**


The Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance (RAQA) Project Manager serves as a strategic project management partner to Regulatory Affairs \& Quality Assurance leadership, with integrated project management responsibility for regulatory strategy execution and quality\-assurance readiness across development programs. The role translates regulatory strategies, health authority requirements, quality\-system obligations, and technical decisions into coordinated cross\-functional plans from clinical development through marketing application submission, approval, launch readiness, and post\-approval lifecycle management.


Reporting to the Program Management \& Operations organization, the RAQA Project Manager partners closely with Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC), Clinical Development, Clinical Development \& Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Writing, Pharmacovigilance, Supply Chain, Commercial, Legal, and external partners. The position places primary emphasis on regulatory planning, submission execution, health authority engagement, regulatory commitments, and inspection and compliance readiness, while integrating associated Quality Assurance activities into unified project plans.


**Roles and Responsibilities**


* Partner with Regulatory Affairs leadership to translate global and U.S. regulatory strategies into executable plans, including submission pathways, content plans, review timelines, decision points, dependencies, and resource requirements.


* Develop, maintain, and communicate integrated regulatory project plans for assigned programs, covering investigational and marketing applications, amendments, annual reports, meeting requests and briefing packages, responses to health authority information requests, labeling activities, regulatory commitments, and post\-approval submissions.


* Drive cross\-functional planning and operational execution for New Drug Application (NDA) submissions, including integrated content plans across Modules 1 through 5, document authoring and review workflows, publishing and submission\-readiness milestones, critical\-path management, and final filing activities.


* Coordinate regulatory deliverables across Regulatory Affairs, CMC, Clinical, Nonclinical, Quality Assurance, Product Launch, and external partners, ensuring owners, due dates, dependencies, and acceptance criteria are clearly defined.


* Plan and facilitate health authority interactions by coordinating meeting strategy, supporting briefing\-package development, question\-and\-answer preparation, rehearsals, meeting logistics, minutes, commitments, and post\-meeting action tracking.


* Maintain regulatory RAID and decision logs, submission trackers, correspondence logs, commitment registers, and governance materials; proactively identify risks to submission quality, completeness, timing, approvability, or regulatory compliance and facilitate mitigation plans.


* Coordinate responses to health authority questions and requests for information by establishing response teams, timelines, review and approval pathways, source\-document traceability, and readiness checkpoints.


* Support regulatory intelligence and impact assessments by tracking relevant guidance, precedents, policy changes, and agency feedback, and translating potential impacts into program actions, decision requests, and schedule updates.


* Integrate Quality Assurance activities that support regulatory execution, including inspection readiness, audit and inspection commitments, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) tracking, deviation and change\-control dependencies, document\-control requirements, and Good Practice (GxP) compliance deliverables.


* Partner with Quality Assurance and functional leaders to coordinate inspection\-readiness plans, mock inspections, evidence\-room and document requests, subject\-matter\-expert preparation, response tracking, and remediation follow\-through.


* Facilitate RAQA governance by preparing decision\-focused materials, documenting decisions and actions, monitoring follow\-through, and escalating unresolved risks, resource constraints, and cross\-functional conflicts through appropriate governance forums.


* Develop dashboards and executive reporting that communicate submission readiness, milestone performance, critical\-path status, health authority interactions, regulatory risks, quality\-readiness indicators, commitments, and decisions required.

jobs.description:

* Not Remote
* Administration
* JOB219267


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


Were a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


Fluorescence Imaging at Intuitive Surgical


The Fluorescence Imaging Team at Intuitive is developing agents designed to work seamlessly with Intuitive’s robotic platforms and Firefly imaging technology. The agents have the potential to highlight critical anatomy and disease in real time—giving surgeons clearer information at the moment decisions matter most and helping improve outcomes for patients.


If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here.

* Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, timelines, budgets, resources, and risk management strategies

* Strong understanding of the drug development lifecycle, from discovery through commercialization.

* Strong interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to influence without authority to deliver broad impact
* Experience working with senior leadership and presenting to executive stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to synthesize complex topics into clear, actionable plans
* Highly motivated, detail\-oriented, and adaptable in fast\-paced, dynamic environments

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Prior experience in biopharmaceutical launch
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred.
* Knowledge of Design Controls under US and International Regulations preferred.
* Proven ability to think strategically, plan and align product development with business goals and market needs.

jobs.title: Partner 20, Program Manager, Global Partnerships
jobs.description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth\-stage technology companies, across AI, bio \+ healthcare, consumer, crypto, enterprise, fintech, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B\+ under management across multiple funds.



We've established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company\-building process; we know what it's like to be in the founder's shoes. We've invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.


**The Role**
------------



We are looking for a Program Manager to drive execution across the Global Partnerships team. This role will manage roadshows and LP engagements, coordinate GP and LP availability, and lead projects that span the team. The ideal candidate brings structure to complex logistics, keeps stakeholders and priorities aligned, and ensures that commitments, deliverables, and follow\-ups move forward on time.



The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, anticipates needs before they are voiced, exercises sound judgment with highly sensitive information, and thrives in a fast\-moving, high\-stakes environment. You see around corners, sweat the details, and operate with a sense of ownership over outcomes, not just tasks.



We are open to candidates based in the San Francisco Bay Area. This role requires an in\-office presence and flexibility to support travel and time\-sensitive needs.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


**Roadshows and GP/LP Engagement**


* Manage roadshows and LP events from planning through execution, including schedules, venues, accommodations, transportation, security, briefing materials, and day\-of logistics
* Coordinate GP and LP availability across multiple stakeholders, locations, and time zones, proactively resolving conflicts and schedule changes
* Drive the LP engagement cadence by maintaining the engagement calendar and CRM, tracking meetings and commitments, and ensuring timely follow\-up
* Coordinate and host LP experiences, ensuring each visit is polished, welcoming, and consistent with the a16z brand
* Drive LP\-related deliverables, including fundraising milestones, DDQs, and data\-room requests, by managing timelines, coordinating inputs, and guiding materials through review and approval across multiple stakeholders


**Team Programs and Projects**


* Drive cross\-team projects from kickoff through completion, establishing work plans, timelines, owners, and clear deliverables
* Lead working sessions, track decisions and action items, and keep contributors aligned and accountable
* Manage recurring team workflows, templates, and trackers, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and consistency
* Maintain visibility into team priorities, dependencies, and commitments, surfacing risks and conflicts before they affect execution
* Take on additional strategic and operational projects based on the team's evolving priorities

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


* 5\-8\+ years in operations, program management, or supporting senior executives in a fast\-paced environment (e.g., venture capital, finance, professional services, or high\-growth tech), with meaningful exposure to complex logistics
* Proven track record managing complex multi\-city travel and high\-stakes external events from planning through flawless execution
* Exceptional organizational skills and obsessive attention to detail; able to manage many moving parts simultaneously without dropping a thread
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the polish and judgment to interface directly with LPs, senior leaders, and external partners
* Strong project management ability, with the range to take initiatives from 0 to 1, set timelines, and drive them to completion with minimal oversight
* Sound judgment and absolute discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information
* Comfort with ambiguity and a high rate of change; able to re\-prioritize quickly without compromising quality
* Proficiency with modern productivity, scheduling, and travel tools

**Ideal Candidate Background**
------------------------------


* You have a sense of urgency and value the courtesy of professional responsiveness (this is super important as speed is a form of client service)
* You anticipate needs and solve problems before they become problems; you see around corners
* You are able to adapt on the fly and handle unforeseen developments with ease, without compromising attention to detail and quality
* You strive to be an enabler who gives the leader and the team maximum leverage; there is no job too big, no job too small
* You do what you say you are going to do, when you say you are going to do it
* You continually search for new ideas and means of improvement
* You have low ego, high empathy, and the capacity to collaborate effectively
* Most importantly, you take your work seriously but not yourself too seriously


The anticipated salary range for this role is between $222,000 \- $259,000, actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope.



This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K plan, vacation, and sick leave.

**a16z culture**
----------------


* We do only first class business and only in a first class way
* We take a long view of relationships, because we are in the relationship business
* We believe in the future and bet the firm that way
*

jobs.title: Senior NPI Project Manager
jobs.description:
**The Company**


Halo Industries has invented a revolutionary technology to replace a decades\-old semiconductor material slicing process. Our laser\-based technology eliminates waste, improves material cost and performance, and drives advancements in high\-growth markets like automotive, telecommunications, and power electronics. Founded in 2014 at Stanford University, Halo is well\-funded and poised for rapid growth, engaging strategic customers and preparing for volume manufacturing.

**The Opportunity**


The evolution of Halo’s technology and equipment, growing from an R\&D focus to a production manufacturing environment, has triggered the need for a Sr. NPI Project Manager who can help to coordinate the successful transition of its equipment manufacturing from the R\&D engineering team to the NPI equipment build team.

**Job Description**


The Sr. NPI Project Manager will coordinate the transfer of equipment build responsibilities to the NPI team and the timely and successful deployment of that equipment into production. Responsibilities include:

* Manage detailed project schedules, risk registers, and status reports for equipment builds
* Define project deliverables for NPI engineers, allocate and track tasks, and closely monitor progress
* Proactively identify and overcome obstacles to timely delivery of equipment and knowledge transfer. This requires hands\-on, detailed involvement in the daily work of the NPI engineering team.
* Coordinate cross\-functional collaboration to transfer knowledge, processes, and documents between the R\&D engineering and NPI teams
* Manage the NPI technical writing team’s development of all documents required for this transfer
* Drive PLM phase gate readiness for product design and production release
* Aid in determining the product or system requirements
* Drive continuous improvement in NPI processes, equipment, and tooling
* Coordinate the bringup of NPI equipment in halo’s international volume fabrication facilities
* Present project status to the Halo management team and participate in strategic planning activity

  

**Requirements** **Education \& Experience**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Material Science, Physics, or related discipline
* A minimum of 4 years of NPI project management experience for complex engineering systems, preferably in the semiconductor industry
* Experience transitioning products from prototype to production/manufacturing scale
* Experience leading teams comprising 5 to 10 NPI engineers

**What We’re Looking For**

* High proficiency with modern project management tools and collaborative productivity tools
* Strong detail\-oriented organizational skills
* Strong technical communication skills with the capability to lead and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team and communicate status to all stakeholders
* Ability to work effectively in a highly dynamic environment where priorities and schedules are subject to change
* Ownership mentality, with ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Ability to build and sustain cooperative working relationships with managers, colleagues, and external partners
* Familiarity with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems

**Bonus**

* Experience with Arena PLM, Jira, Confluence, and Google Workspace applications (particularly Google Sheets)
* Project management certification (e.g., PMP)
* Experience in startup environments

  

**Benefits** ***Benefits***

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Free Food \& Snacks
* Stock Option Plan
* Annual Bonus Plan eligible
* Short Term \& Long Term Disability

***Additional Information***


We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and supported. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities in STEM. If you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.


Base salary range: $140k \- $160k

jobs.title: Program Manager II, Privacy, Safety and Security, Core Systems
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; San Jose, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program or project management.
* 2 years of experience with security or privacy domain.
* Experience managing and delivering internal events, including meetings or summits.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience in a technology or security\-focused organization.
* Experience with Google Workspace tools and other communication/event platforms.
* Experience working in a strategy and operations, chief of staff, or similar capacity.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Privacy, Safety and Security (PSS) Strategy and Operations team works to enable Privacy, Safety and Security to deliver on its mission of keeping everyone safe, at scale. We drive strategic initiatives, optimize operations, and foster cross\-functional alignment across Privacy, Safety and Security and with partner organizations throughout Google.


This unique role blends deep communications expertise with strong program management skills. You will work closely with Privacy, Safety and Security leadership, Chief of Staff, and teams across the pillar to ensure our internal communications are clear, consistent, and effective.


This role requires exceptional program management and communication skills, a flair for creative and engaging content, strong event planning capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.


The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $132000 \- $189000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Help develop and execute an overarching internal communications and employee engagement strategy for Privacy, Safety and Security (aligned with organizational priorities. Define scope, goals, deliverables, and timelines while managing dependencies, risks, and change management efforts.
* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution for major Privacy, Safety and Security events (e.g., all hands, leadership summits, speaker series) and culture\-building initiatives to drive alignment and employee engagement.
* Establish metrics and feedback loops to measure the impact and effectiveness of communications and events, using data to continuously iterate and refine strategies.
* Translate complex technical concepts and strategic updates into clear, compelling narratives for internal audiences. Craft high\-quality content across various channels (e.g., emails, newsletters, intranet sites, and presentations).
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:
**OUR COMMITMENT TO A HUMAN HIRING PROCESS**



We believe every candidate deserves thoughtful consideration. That's why we do not use AI or automated systems to review applications. Every application is reviewed by a real human member of our team. Because we take the time to give each submission the attention it deserves, our review process may take a little longer — and we genuinely appreciate your patience as we work through applications carefully and respectfully.


**SERVICE AREA PREFERENCE**



While we encourage all interested applicants to apply, we do give priority to those who live in, or near, our service counties: Santa Cruz, Monterey, Merced, San Benito, and Mariposa. Our mission of *accessible, quality health care guided by local innovation*leads everything we do, and having team members who are connected to the communities we serve strengthens our ability to deliver on that commitment.


#### **ABOUT THIS TEMP POSITION**



This is a temporary position and is available remotely for those residing in California. The length of the assignment is estimated to go from September 2026 through December 2026, but this is always dependent on business need, and these dates may change. While the assignment would be at the Alliance, you would be an employee of a temporary employment agency that we would connect you with if hired for this position.This is a full\-time (40 hours/week) temporary assignment.


**WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**



Reporting to the Enterprise Project Management Manager, this position:


* Provides intermediate\-level project management support for medium to high complexity cross\-functional, systems\-driven strategic and operational projects involving interdepartmental units and/or external stakeholder teams through all aspects of the project lifecycle
* Conducts intermediate\-level business, technical and financial analysis and reporting to support operations and business development
* Effectively utilizes, implements and communicates project management methodologies and policies, and mentors project teams, project stakeholders and Enterprise Project Managers, to ensure accuracy, consistency and thoroughness

  


**ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Project Management Office (PMO) is a key part of our Operational Excellence Department, committed to *providing and growing operational effectiveness expertise across the organization*. As the PMO team, we contribute to that commitment through enterprise Portfolio, Program and Project Management services, enabling the organization to operationally adapt and advance our mission. The PMO's role is to provide practical structure, partnership, and support that makes it easier for teams to deliver meaningful outcomes and focus on what matters most: serving our members well.

  


**IDEAL CANDIDATE**



We are looking for a flexible, adaptable professional who works effectively with stakeholders at all levels and keeps projects moving in a fast\-paced environment. This person communicates clearly, collaborates across teams, and manages the full project lifecycle with strong organization and attention to detail. They are resourceful and solution oriented, able to balance multiple priorities while producing high\-quality documentation. They take ownership of their work, build trust and credibility quickly, foster alignment across teams, and contribute to team success with a constructive, team\-first approach.

  


#### **WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL**

  



To read the full position description and list of requirements, click here.


* **Knowledge of:**
* + Project management methodologies and tools
	+ Windows based PC systems and Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and project management software applications
	+ Methods and tools of meeting facilitation and ability to lead team building exercises and facilitate meetings and/or projects using problem solving and persuasion skills
* **Ability to:**
	+ Demonstrate strong analytical skills and identify issues, offer solutions and mitigate risk
	+ Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner
	+ Maintain organized and accurate records
	+ Accurately collect, interpret and evaluate data, make recommendations, and project consequences of recommendations
	+ Prepare statistical and narrative reports
* **Education and Experience:**
	+ Bachelor's degree in a Business, Health Care or a related field
	+ A minimum of three years of project management experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be qualifying

#### **OTHER INFORMATION**


* We are in a hybrid work environment, and we anticipate that the interview process will take place remotely via Microsoft Teams.
* While some staff may work full telecommuting schedules, attendance at quarterly company\-wide events or department meetings will be expected.
* In\-office or in\-community presence may be required for some positions and is dependent on business need. Details about this can be reviewed during the interview process.
* **This is a temporary position and does not provide the benefits that are listed below (this is standard language from our regular job posts and cannot be altered or removed). Temporary employees on assignment at the Alliance will be connected to a staffing agency with separate benefit options.**


**COMPENSATION INFORMATION**


* **Zone 1 Pay Range: $57\.70 \- $63\.50**  

Typical areas in Zone 1: Santa Cruz, San Benito, and Monterey Counties, Bay Area, Sacramento, Los Angeles and San Diego areas
* **Zone 2 Pay Range: $54\.50 \- $60\.10**  

Typical areas in Zone 2: Mariposa and Merced Counties, Fresno area, Bakersfield, Eastern California, San Luis Obispo area, and the Central Valley (except Sacramento)


The applicable salary ranges are based on work location and are aligned to a zone according to the cost of labor in your area. All ranges are subject to change in the future. We are happy to answer any questions that you have or share the applicable pay zone for your lo

jobs.description:
As NPI Program Manager, you will serve as the primary leader for assigned customer programs and portfolios, driving the execution of customer commitments, operational performance, and business objectives. You will align resources across Molex GSM, translate customer requirements into executable plans, and lead cross\-functional teams through demand planning, delivery, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Account Management, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain \& Operations, Procurement, and Sales, you will ensure priorities, risks, and decisions are effectively managed to support customer success and profitable growth.
Success in this role requires strong business acumen, customer advocacy, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization to drive accountability, disciplined execution, and measurable results. The Program Manager is accountable for overall program performance and customer satisfaction, ensuring alignment between customer priorities and business objectives.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead cross\-functional execution of customer programs and projects, managing priorities, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions to ensure successful delivery of customer and business objectives.
* Serve as the primary program leader and internal customer advocate, aligning customer priorities, contractual commitments, and business objectives with operational capabilities and resources.
* Establish and maintain program governance, including customer reviews, executive business reviews, escalation management, action tracking, performance reporting, and recovery planning.
* Translate customer demand, forecasts, program changes, and strategic priorities into coordinated plans that support delivery, quality, responsiveness, and profitable growth.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate risks while facilitating timely, data\-driven decision\-making to prevent impacts to customer experience or business performance.
* Develop and maintain program plans, dashboards, performance metrics, and communication processes that provide visibility, accountability, and execution discipline.
* Partner with commercial and operational leaders to support strategic account planning, identify growth opportunities, improve forecast accuracy, and protect profitability.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including on\-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, customer satisfaction, and program profitability.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R\&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice\-of\-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.


This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross\-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.


This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy**

* Run structured voice\-of\-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
* Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
* Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

**Architecture and AI Deployment**

* Own end\-to\-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
* Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well\-governed capability that scales across divisions.
* Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
* Track adoption and usage post\-deployment, and course\-correct programs that aren't landing.

**Automation Program Execution**

* Lead program management for cross\-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
* Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
* Manage cross\-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

**Cross\-Functional Governance and Reporting**

* Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
* Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross\-program dependencies.
* Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10\+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R\&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
* Systems engineering background or hands\-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
* Experience running voice\-of\-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
* Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
* Experience running cross\-divisional or multi\-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems\-level and architecture workflows.
* Skilled at running voice\-of\-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
* Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
* Strong cross\-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.
