jobs.title: RCM Customer Success Specialist 1
jobs.description:
**Join the Team Modernizing Medicine**


At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

**A Culture of Excellence**


When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work**
* **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture\-Backed Company of the Year


We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**

**Job Description Summary:**

jobs.title: Fractional Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Sunny's Gourmet Products · Part\-time · Remote with travel to Mishawaka, Indiana**

Sunny's Gourmet Products manufactures authentic Korean sauces and seasonings — all\-natural, chef\-developed, and built on recipes our founder refined over more than thirty years, first in her own restaurant kitchen and now as a packaged goods line. We distribute nationally through KeHE, with UNFI in progress, alongside self\-distribution and Amazon, and hold retail placement across the Midwest and beyond.

**The opportunity**

This is a new role and a broad one. Our founder has run production directly since the beginning, and this next stage calls for formalizing what she has built — specifications, quality standards, supplier and cost systems — so it scales with us.

You would own that work end to end and design most of it rather than inherit it. For an operator who would rather build than maintain, there is real room here, and the role is structured to grow as the company does.

**The first six months**

*Month 1 — Get oriented.* Meet the team, learn the products, and map the current state across records, suppliers, contracts, certifications, and working arrangements. Deliver a current\-state map and a prioritized roadmap.

*Months 2–3 — On\-site intensive.* Two consecutive days in Mishawaka working directly with the founder and observing live production, capturing formulation, process parameters, and quality standards. A structured question bank and capture protocol are ready for you.

*Months 3–4 — Documentation.* Master specifications for four SKUs, quality standards with defined acceptance criteria, and core operating procedures.

*Months 4–6 — Build the operating record.* Supplier and packaging master with terms and lead times, SKU\-level cost build and COGS, logistics and fulfillment, and the compliance documentation our distribution partners require.

**Ongoing**

* Own and maintain the specification and procedure library
* Supplier relationships, purchasing cadence, and terms
* Cost tracking and margin analysis by SKU and channel
* Retailer and distributor compliance documentation and new item setup
* Co\-manufacturer qualification as we expand capacity
* Production planning and inventory as volume grows

**Required**

* Documentation experience in a regulated manufacturing environment — food, pharmaceutical, or medical device. Food preferred.
* Fluency in controlled documentation: specifications, batch records, operating procedures, and change control
* Experience building operating systems, not only maintaining them
* Experience working directly with a founder\-operator
* Self\-directed, and comfortable owning a function end to end

**Preferred**

* Food manufacturing background, particularly shelf\-stable products
* HACCP, GMP, and FSMA fluency
* Experience taking a small brand into co\-manufacturing
* Familiarity with KeHE and UNFI mechanics, trade spend, and deductions
* SKU\-level cost accounting
* Based in the South Bend–Elkhart area — convenient for the on\-site work, though not required

**Terms**

Independent contractor on a monthly retainer. Approximately 30 hours per month at $1,600–1,800, depending on experience and scope. Twelve\-month horizon with a path to a full\-time operations role as revenue supports it. Remote — on\-site work in Mishawaka is expected to be roughly 10% of the engagement or less, concentrated in the intensive. Airfare and lodging arranged and paid by SGP, ground transportation reimbursed. Mutual NDA prior to disclosure.

**To apply**

Send relevant experience with particular attention to operations work you built rather than inherited; one sample deliverable you authored (redaction is fine); your read on where you would start; and your availability.

Pay: $1,600\.00 \- $1,800\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.


Do you find the slow pace of drug development unacceptable? Are you ready to use cutting\-edge technology to accelerate the completion of cancer clinical trials? \#LI\-DA1


$65,000\-$100,000

Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. jobs.title: Accounting Operations Manager
jobs.description:
FRINGE · REMOTE (US), OFFICE IN RICHMOND, VA · FULL\-TIME


**Accounting Operations Manager**


**About Fringe**


Fringe is a fast\-growing HR technology company based in Virginia. Founded in late 2018, Fringe is the first ever platform for personalized lifestyle benefits. We are a relentlessly people\-focused group revolutionizing the way employers care for their people in the benefits space. We're a supportive, down\-to\-earth team, fully committed to the belief that relationships fuel outstanding client experience.


We built Fringe to give companies a better way to show love and care to their people. Because we believe it's the people who really matter. Companies exist because of the products and services they offer, but we believe the people within them should come first. At Fringe, this is the way we live.


Practically, this means we hire people who care about their teammates just as much as (if not more than) themselves. We hire people who are genuine, humble, willing to learn, ready to teach, able to adapt, flex, collaborate, celebrate each other, win together and lose together.


We're a startup, and that means we must be a courageous group. We solve problems all day, but we also mess up sometimes. We extend grace to each other, and we try again. We aren't looking for perfect people. We're looking for people who own their faults, play to their strengths, and have the courage to simply be the same person all the time.


If that doesn't sound like your cup of cold brew, no hard feelings. But that's exactly who we are and what you can expect when you work at Fringe.


**About the role**


Fringe's employee experience platform combines a B2B model with a B2B2C marketplace. Employers pay us a subscription and fund lifestyle benefits, swag, recognition, and gifting for their people. Employees spend those dollars as points in our marketplace across hundreds of vendors. We pay the vendors. That means we run a SaaS business and a marketplace at the same time, with deferred revenue, points liabilities, and a cohort of channel partners layered on top. If you find that combination energizing rather than intimidating, keep reading.


You'll be the in\-house finance and accounting leader at Fringe and will take over a well\-built set of documented, repeatable close processes. You will own the monthly close and everything that comes out of it, run our financial operations end to end, and be the person everyone at Fringe comes to with a finance question. You'll report to the COO and work closely with Operations and Product.


This is a role for a professional who wants to jump into a startup environment and own a whole function. It is a lot of hats and it is a rare amount of scope, ownership, and visibility..


**What you'll own**


**Monthly close and reporting**


* Run the full monthly close: close calendar, journal entries, reconciliations, and sign\-off across subscription and marketplace revenue.
* Own revenue recognition under ASC 606 for a hybrid model: PEPM subscriptions, employer\-funded marketplace spend, gifting, and partner revenue share.
* Maintain deferred revenue and points liability roll\-forwards and keep the balance sheet clean and explainable.
* Produce internal and external monthly reporting: variance and flux analysis and the executive dashboard.
* Support the annual audit and tax processes with our outside CPA firms.


**Financial operations**


* Treasury and cash: cash forecast, bank relationships, managing operating balances, and executing outbound wires and ACH payments with proper approvals.
* Accounts payable, accounts receivable and collections in partnership with Customer Success: customer invoicing and billing accuracy, vendor payment runs, and chasing what's past due.
* Payroll, working with People Operations and our PEO.
* Review all accounting work and ensure a high standard.


**Cross\-functional partner**


* Be the main point of contact for all things finance internally: contract terms, vendor questions, funding schedules, commission plans, budgets.
* Spot the process that's slowing us down and fix it. Drive operational improvement rather than waiting for someone to ask.


**Who you are**


* High agency and a bias for action. You'd rather ship a good answer today than a perfect one next week, and you know which situations call for which.
* Comfortable being the only finance person in the room, and honest about when you need a second set of eyes.
* A clear communicator who can explain a flux to the CEO, a payment term to a salesperson, and a rev rec judgment to an auditor.
* Curious about how the business actually works, not just how it's booked.
* Someone who owns mistakes, extends grace, and shows up as the same person every day. That's who we are.


**Need to haves**


* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience.
* Deep understanding of GAAP, especially ASC 606\.
* Hands\-on experience running monthly close procedures and meeting internal and external reporting requirements.
* Familiarity with an accounting tech stack and a spreadsheet wizard (Quickbooks, Tabs, Anrok, FloQast, Salesforce, Claude, Google Sheets)
* Strong leadership, analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to drive operational improvement.
* Quality communicator, written and verbal.


**Nice to haves**


* Experience at Big 4, high\-growth startup, management consulting, or investment banking.
* CPA (active or license applicant).
* SaaS or marketplace experience, especially with deferred revenue, points or stored value, or multi\-party revenue.


**What we offer**


Fringe is remote\-first, with an office in Richmond, VA for those who want it. Beyond the scope of the role itself, here's what comes with it:


* Competitive salary.
* Employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for individuals and families.
* 3% company match on 401(k) retirement

* Lead and coach the consignment team on day\-to\-day inventory operations – inventory\-on\-hand analysis, back\-order monitoring, and near\-expiration reporting – working hands\-on with the team to make timely recommendations to the field.

Education

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager is an advanced project management professional who handles the largest and most complex automation projects, planning and overseeing multiple concurrent project implementations to ensure they are completed on time and within budget. This role develops and manages project plans, designates project resources and prepares budgets, and monitors project status. The Senior Project Manager identifies and troubleshoots issues and keeps stakeholders informed throughout the implementation of the project.

  


**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  




* Oversees all aspects of the project lifecycle: planning, scope definition, design, execution, and delivery. Organizes and oversees the staffing of the project.
* Ensures the engineering integrity of systems such that the contractual specifications are met with respect to system functionality, productivity, reliability, quality, and safety.
* Maintains and regularly updates project schedule, open items list, and risk register.


* Manages project budget and forecasting of costs. Proactively identifies potential over\-runs and develops mitigation plan to minimize negative impact to project.
* Coordinates with engineering, purchasing, and manufacturing for material requisitions and equipment deliveries to meet project milestones. Monitors progress against milestones, budget guidelines, and other performance indicators.
* Balances concurrent assignments as Project Manager, managing responsibilities such as developing bid packages, evaluating bids, processing POs, and monitoring vendors. Assists with the selection of vendors and manages all activities regarding external consultants and vendors.
* Keeps management informed of on\-going issues and potential concerns that may be escalated by the customer.


* Maintains comprehensive and complete documentation of situations that can lead to claims against TGW.


* Performs additional duties as required.

  


**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent technical systems experience.

  




**Experience:** Minimum of six (6\) years of technical systems experience, preferably in material handling industry.

  




**Travel:** Approximately 60% of domestic and international travel as required.

  




**Skills \& Abilities**

  




* Strong background in engineering automation industry
* System\-level working knowledge of Mechanical, PLC Controls, and Software Engineering
* Demonstrated experience leading and managing large project teams
* Strong proficiency with project management software (e.g. Microsoft Project)
* Excellent communication skills, with ability to communicate effectively across a variety of audiences.
* Robust knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)
* Formal Project Management certification (e.g., PRINCE2, PMI, or other recognized methodologies) preferred.

  




**Physical Requirements**

  




* Ability to remain stationary at a desk for prolonged periods of time.
* Ability to go to site frequently and move safely around industrial and/or warehouse environment.
* Ability to lift and carry supplies up to 25 pounds at a time.


* Ability to operate computers, tablets, phones, and other electronic devices.
* Ability to communicate with others verbally and in writing, on a frequent basis.


* Ability to tolerate exposure to job site temperature fluctuations due to seasonal weather in geographic region.

  




The physical demands described above are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  




**Other Requirements**

  




This position may require work at TGW customer sites. TGW’s customers may require background checks before accessing their sites. Refusal to participate in a customer\-required background check may result in a customer barring access and a subsequent reduction in work.

  




**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Requisition ID: 2026\-4658 Job Summary:

We seek an experienced Project Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Strategic Planning Division (SPD)/Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI). CCPI advances VHA as a center for the development of data\-driven, value\-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden, and leads legislatively directed pilot initiatives. This role will serve as the Task Order (TO) Project Manager, the primary Contractor point of contact with SPD/CCPI and the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), supporting a portfolio of up to six concurrent pilots and associated CCPI program management activities, working closely with the contract\-aligned Program Director, workstream leads, and Government leadership to ensure task order requirements are executed consistently and in accordance with VA standards and enterprise objectives.

  


Primary Responsibilities:

The Project Manager is responsible for maintaining the Government\-approved Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Charter, integrated schedule, milestones, RAID Log, and Stakeholder Registry, and for developing and maintaining a Portfolio Management Dashboard that provides portfolio\-wide visibility into status, milestones, risks, dependencies, decision points, and funding across all active pilots and workstreams. This includes leading a weekly status meeting with the COR and producing a Weekly Task Report; preparing a semi\-monthly budget and schedule tracker and a Monthly Progress Report covering budget, schedule, staffing, and performance; and preparing scoping letters for emerging in\-scope requirements, as requested by the Government. The role also facilitates working sessions, stakeholder meetings, and decision\-making forums, and maintains centralized repositories, action trackers, and risk/issue logs necessary to support program continuity and portfolio oversight.

  

In this role, the Project Manager collaborates with the Program Director, Pilot Project Manager, Stakeholder Engagement \& Communications Specialist, and Technical Writer/Editor to ensure coordinated execution across the SPD/CCPI portfolio and supports development of executive\-ready briefing materials for SES leadership, governance bodies, and Congressional reporting. Responsibilities include tracking approved scope changes; maintaining organized project files using version control and records management practices; and providing Government customers with timely reporting on status, schedule, risks, issues, and performance metrics to support informed decision\-making.

* Bachelor's degree (BA/BS)
* Minimum four (4\) years of experience successfully managing a large\-scale, complex program encompassing multiple projects
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, with a minimum of four (4\) years' experience supporting a large corporation or government agency, preferably a large health care organization
* Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
* Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and pass a VA background investigation.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States (no visa sponsorship).

* Master’s degree
* Eight (8\) or more years of experience managing large\-scale, complex programs or projects, preferably within a large health care organization
* Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or Veterans Health Administration (VHA), particularly program/portfolio management, pilot or innovation programs, or value\-based health care initiatives
* Familiarity with federal health care environments and legislatively directed pilot programs, waiver processes, or enterprise transformation initiatives

This individual will be responsible for managing the full project lifecycle, coordinating cross\-functional delivery teams, maintaining strong client relationships, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.

jobs.title: Program Launch Manager
jobs.description:
**About Convergent Research**
-----------------------------



Convergent Research is a nonprofit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO). We design, launch, and support mission\-driven, time\-bound organizations built to solve important scientific and engineering bottlenecks.



FROs are designed to tackle the kinds of problems that benefit from unusual levels of focus, coordination, and scale. Convergent provides the operational backbone that allows FRO teams to move quickly—from legal formation, funding, hiring, finance, and governance to partnerships, communications, and operational systems.



We’ve now taken 14 FROs from idea to operating entity, including four launches in 2026\. And we’re not slowing down.

  


**About the Role**
------------------



Turning an ambitious scientific idea into a functioning organization requires a lot more than good science.



There are entities to form, teams to hire, systems to stand up, funders and partners to coordinate, decisions to make, and approximately one million details that need to happen in the right order. At the same time, the founders doing this work are often building an organization for the first time.



That’s where you come in.



As our **Program Launch Manager**, you’ll sit at the center of the FRO lifecycle. You’ll help promising scientific projects become functioning organizations while also running large\-scale founder programs that develop the next generation of FROs.



You’ll be part project manager, part operator, and part trusted partner. One minute you might be building a launch plan across legal, finance, people, and IT. The next, you’re helping a scientist understand an unfamiliar operational decision, chasing down a dependency that could delay launch, or making sure a founder residency participant has what they need to make progress.



This isn’t a traditional project\-management or account\-management role. Our systems and playbooks are still evolving, and every FRO is different. You’ll need to bring structure without creating bureaucracy, keep things moving without losing sight of the people involved, and turn what we learn from every launch into a better system for the next one.



### **You Are (Skills):**

* **A project manager who can make ambiguity actionable.** Give you a complicated goal with multiple teams, unclear dependencies, and a moving timeline, and you can turn it into a practical plan. You know who owns what, what needs to happen next, where the risks are, and which decisions are holding everything else up.
* **Operationally rigorous.** You notice the details that matter. You keep accurate records, follow through reliably, and know that a small operational gap today can become a much larger problem three weeks from now.
* **People\-centered and emotionally intelligent.** Launching an organization can be exciting, confusing, stressful, and occasionally all three before lunch. You build trust quickly, meet people where they are, and know when to coach, facilitate, advise, push, or simply listen.
* **A confident, clear, proactive communicator.** You can run an effective meeting, write a concise status update, ask the uncomfortable\-but\-important question, and translate complicated processes into something another human can actually understand. You’re equally comfortable working with scientists, founders, executives, vendors, funders, and functional specialists.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity.** You’ve worked somewhere entrepreneurial—perhaps a startup, nonprofit, consultancy, research organization, or similar environment—where not every process came with an instruction manual. You bring structure while recognizing that the right answer may be different for every FRO.
* **A fan of functional systems.** After doing something manually for the fifth time, you start wondering whether there’s a better way. You like turning bespoke work into useful processes, templates, documentation, and operating rhythms—and you’re interested in using automation and AI thoughtfully when they can make those systems better.
* **A great juggler.** Multiple launches, founder programs, stakeholders, decisions, and deadlines don’t scare you. You can manage several workstreams at once, adjust when priorities change, and keep things moving without adding unnecessary process.

### **You Will (Duties):**

* **Lead FRO launches.** You’ll own the day\-to\-day coordination of one or more FRO launches, bringing together Convergent’s legal, finance, people, compliance, procurement, IT, fundraising, communications, and leadership teams. You’ll build and manage launch plans from proposal approval and funding commitment through entity formation, operational activation, team onboarding, and early FRO execution. You’ll run launch meetings, track decisions and dependencies, surface risks early, resolve blockers, and help coordinate launches across both U.S. and international contexts.
* **Run founder programs.** You’ll own the operational delivery of FRO Founder Residencies, open calls, Launchpad programs, and other partner\-led initiatives—from planning and participant onboarding through programming, selection, and closeout. You’ll coordinate program design, participant experience, and internal operational work while providing thoughtful, high\-touch support to founders and teams.
* **Be a trusted partner to FRO founders.** You’ll serve as a consistent and responsive point of contact for founders and FRO leaders during launch and early operations. You’ll help them understand Convergent’s operating model, systems, decision rights, governance expectations, and available support. You’ll advocate for their needs while also helping them navigate the realities of building a new organization.
* **Listen and learn.** Every FRO teaches us something. You’ll create structured feedback loops with FRO teams to understand what is working, where friction exists, and what they need from Convergent. Then you’ll m

**Reports to:** NCCCP Project Manager  
**Salary Range:** $61,000\-$66,000/year DOQ  
**Classification:** Full\-time, Exempt  
**Location:** Remote

**To Apply: A resume and cover letter detailing your interest in the position and relevant experience are required. Applications submitted without both will be automatically rejected**

**About AICAF**  
The American Indian Cancer Foundation (AICAF), a national nonprofit, is committed to supporting Native cancer patients, communities, tribal leaders, and healthcare providers with the knowledge and resources to improve cancer prevention, early detection, treatment, and survivorship outcomes across Indian Country. By educating and empowering, we can collectively work towards a cancer\-free future for our people and future generations.

**Position Summary**  
The NCCCP Project Coordinator position will focus primarily on the National Comprehensive Cancer Control Program (NCCCP), a nationwide initiative overseen by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Through this program, the American Indian Cancer Foundation (AICAF) works to advance comprehensive cancer control efforts by collaborating with Tribal Nations, Indigenous organizations, and partners to reduce the burden of cancer among American Indian and Alaska Native communities.

The NCCCP Project Coordinator will work closely with, and under the supervision of, the NCCCP Project Manager and will assist with the implementation of the NCCCP Program. As the NCCCP Project Coordinator you will assist with and support the project efforts that include but are not limited to: 1\) coalition building and facilitation, community engagement, collaboration, and buy\-in support with various entities, such as tribal, local, state, and national organizations; 2\) the development and dissemination of culturally tailored materials and messaging; 3\) knowledge of traditional tobacco practices; 4\) the ability to implement activities and strategies to support positive outcomes; and 5\) familiarity and capacity to understand and implement policy, systems, and environmental changes related to colorectal cancer, tobacco cessation, lung cancer, and survivorship.

Please Note: while the primary focus of this role involves this ongoing NCCCP Project, you may be asked to contribute to other tasks or projects, temporarily or permanently, as determined by organizational needs.

**Responsibilities**

* Work closely with the NCCCP Project Manager and as part of a team to review and establish program goals and deliverables, work plans, and timelines.
* Coordinate internal and external communications and maintain informative and respectful communications with various stakeholders (community partners, staff, coalition partners, consultants, and funders).
* Participate in the development and review of culturally tailored resources (educational materials, training and tools)
* Support the team in planning, tool development, recruitment, approvals, data collection, analysis, interpretation, and dissemination.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Care Coordinator - Clinical Pharmacy Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**A bit about this role:**


Devoted Medical is building clinical programs to manage and coordinate care in a manner consistent with Devoted's values of treating every member like family. Medication plays a crucial role in helping people manage chronic conditions, but in many cases effective medication management is limited by barriers to access, uncoordinated prescribing, or a failure to use the most effective evidence\-based medication therapies. For example, despite a mountain of evidence, less than 1 in 10 people with congestive heart failure (CHF) are prescribed evidence\-based medications proven to save lives and prevent hospitalizations.


Devoted's clinical pharmacy team aims to support improved therapeutics for Devoted members. It supports this work in three ways:

* *Conducting medication reviews (via direct member engagement and pharmacist consult support for other clinicians)*
* *Virtual pharmacist\-led or clinician\-led care via telemedicine to close therapy gaps*
* *Coordinating care for changes in therapy by counseling members and engaging prescribers and pharmacies*

**This work is done in service of a number of goals. The clinical pharmacy team drives Devoted's quality and Medicare Stars performance across multiple programs such as:**

* **SUPD (Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes)**
* **SPC (Statin Use in Persons with Heart Disease)**
* **MTM (Medication Therapy Management)**
* **TCC (Total Cost of Care)**
* **Polypharmacy**


During appointments with our pharmacists and clinicians, medication opportunities are identified.That's where Pharmacy Care Coordinators (PCCs) step in. PCCs ensure recommendations reach the outside provider, follow up with pharmacies on claims issues, pick\-up confirmations, or discontinuations, and keep the member informed of any changes along the way.


As a PCC, you will partner with our Clinical Pharmacy and Operations teams on outreach, coordination, and follow\-up to provide best in class care to our members, as part of a mission\-driven, team\-oriented, joyful culture.

 **Responsibilities and Impact will include:**

* Supports clinical outreach campaigns by making outbound calls and utilizing portal chat to members to schedule appointments with the pharmacist team to address clinical gaps or medication concerns
* Supports cost of care efforts by reaching out to providers and members to offer lower cost alternative medication options
* Manages an assigned caseload which may require provider, pharmacy, and/or member follow\-up to address medication recommendations, concerns, or questions
* Independently oversees assigned cases and outreaches with timely follow\-up, clear next steps, and thorough documentation
* Helps members navigate their Devoted Health benefits
* Participates in sprints, pilots, and special projects as they launch
* Collaborates with the broader pharmacy team to support shared goals and coverage needs
* Assists with training and shadowing when new team members join the team
* Participates in team and pharmacy department activities and responsibilities

**Required skills and experience:**

* At least 3 years of work experience in health care or retail pharmacy
* Active National PTCB Certification
* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls to members, providers, and pharmacies
* Comfortable managing daily responsibilities and tasks independently
* Ability to shift between tasks, projects, and priorities frequently

**Desired skills and experience:**

* Highly organized and detail\-driven
* Comfortable learning new software and adapting as tools and workflows evolve
* Adaptable and flexible, with a willingness to take on new or shifting tasks positively
* A true team player who brings new ideas to the table, works through solutions with others, and lifts up their teammates
* Comfortable speaking with physicians, pharmacies, and patients, with a genuine passion for our members
* Thrives in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* A transparent communicator about your work, what's going well, and what's not, with a thoughtful eye for improving processes

***Salary range:*** $23\.00 \- $30\.00 hourly

----------------------------



InSource Solutions is a leading industrial software solutions provider and a trusted partner of AVEVA, a global leader in engineering and industrial software. --------------------



The Training and Commercial Operations Coordinator is responsible for the end\-to\-end coordination and administration of InSource's training programs while also supporting sales and operations teams with customer onboarding and commercial account setup.



This role serves as the primary point of contact for training registrations, inquiries, scheduling, payment coordination, and logistics, helping ensure a seamless experience for students while supporting trainers in delivering an organized and financially effective training operation.



The Training and Commercial Operations Coordinator also supports customer onboarding activities, including documentation collection, credit checks, insurance compliance, and account setup. By coordinating closely with Sales, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and Client Success, this role helps ensure customer accounts are properly established and compliant before order processing begins.



Success in this role requires strong organization, attention to detail, customer service, cross\-functional collaboration, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines and stakeholders across both training and commercial operations.

* **Class Enrollment Management:** Work with the VP of Client Success and trainers to identify underenrolled classes and determine whether cancellation is appropriate. Notify registered students of cancellations and proactively provide alternative options.
* **Training Registration Processing:** Process inbound training registrations received through the company website and direct email. Ensure each registration includes valid payment or an authorized coupon and confirm enrollment only after applicable requirements are satisfied.
* **Payment and Coupon Administration:** Process credit card payments directly, prepare quotes for purchase\-order or invoice\-based registrations, and process resulting purchase orders. Validate training coupons against authorized coupon types, including unlimited training subscriptions and System Integrator seats.

* **Insurance and Compliance Administration:** Collect, verify, and maintain Certificates of Insurance in accordance with customer requirements and ensure applicable onboarding and compliance documentation is complete.
* **Credit and Commercial Setup:** Initiate and monitor credit checks and collaborate with Finance to establish customer credit terms.
* **Cross\-Functional Commercial Support:** Act as a liaison among Sales, Finance, and Operations to resolve onboarding issues and ensure customer accounts are prepared for efficient order processing.
* **Accounts Receivable Support:** Assist Accounts Receivable in improving cash collection timelines and reducing days sales outstanding by proactively addressing customer setup, documentation, credit, and compliance issues that could delay invoicing or payment.
* **Risk and Issue Management:** Identify and escalate risks, missing documentation, compliance concerns, or delays that could impact customer onboarding or order\-processing timelines.
* **Process Improvement:** Support continuous improvement initiatives across training administration, customer onboarding, and commercial operations processes.

**Summary**
-----------


Yelp’s User Operations department is searching for a detail\-oriented, analytically minded person to join our team as a Data Quality Associate.


This individual will be expected to have (or quickly develop) an in\-depth knowledge of Yelp’s business listing policy and front\-end product flows across all platforms.The core of the role will involve conducting quality assessments, identifying trends and patterns in data quality issues, surfacing improvements across data sources, and supporting escalations.  

The Data Quality Associate works cross\-functionally with teams across the User Operations department and the broader business, including coordination with an overseas team, in order to manage day\-to\-day quality operations.  

This is a full\-time remote role based in the United States.**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Assess the data quality of incoming data sources in order to determine viability and reliability.
* Onboard new data sources by running reports to ensure a data match.
* Train internal stakeholders on business listing standards and best practices.
* Develop data quality reporting standards and report quantitative and qualitative results in a concise and informative manner.
* Drive cross\-functional projects and initiatives across various internal teams (ie: engineering, product management and business development).
* Work independently and with other team members while managing stakeholder relationships and engaging in regular data quality discussions.
* Surface data quality issues and drive solutions with tech team stakeholders.
* Execute internal quality assessment exercises to identify poor quality data and zero\-in on calibration needs.
* Identify and drive data improvement projects from start to finish.
* Ensure deadlines are met across all workstreams.
* Maintain and update process documentation, policy references, and training materials as needed.
* Handle urgent escalations and lead in the decision\-making process to resolve the issue.

-----------------------------

* You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
* You have at least 1\-2 years of experience in a quality assurance, operations, moderation, or a similar detail\-driven role.
* You are able to build trackers, pivot tables, and basic formulas in order to organize and analyze data quality in Google Sheets and/or Excel.
* You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, and analyze significant amounts of information, identify patterns, and derive solutions to complex problems.

##### **Responsibilities**


Cardinal Technology Systems Corp. is a government IT solutions provider servicing commercial and government initiative in various parts of the United States. We are currently seeking a Business Analyst / Functional Tester to work for our company.


##### **Summary**


* **Eligibility to obtain a U.S. Government PUBLIC TRUST / SECRET / TOP SECRET Clearance.** **(Basic Federal Clearance requirements are U.S. Citizenship, clear criminal history check, no recent or pending bankruptcies)**
* The Business Analyst / Functional Tester will support business analysis, Agile project delivery, functional testing, and documentation activities for IT systems and software development initiatives.
* Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, developers, testers, and project teams to gather requirements, document business processes, create user stories, develop test cases, support functional testing, track defects, and ensure system functionality aligns with business and customer requirements.
* Support Agile/Scrum project activities, including backlog management, sprint planning, user story development, acceptance criteria, defect tracking, and project documentation.
* Use Jira to manage user stories, tasks, defects, sprint activities, project progress, and related documentation.
* Create, execute, and maintain functional test cases and test scripts to support system testing, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and defect validation.
* Prepare and maintain documentation such as requirements documents, process flows, meeting notes, test documentation, user guides, standard operating procedures, and status updates.


##### **Requirements**


* **Eligibility to obtain a U.S. Government PUBLIC TRUST / SECRET / TOP SECRET Clearance. (Basic Federal Clearance requirements are U.S. Citizenship, clear criminal history check, no recent or pending bankruptcies)**
* 5–7\+ years of relevant experience supporting IT systems, software development, system modernization, application enhancement, or enterprise technology projects.
* 5\+ years of experience working as a Business Analyst, Functional Tester, Business Systems Analyst, QA Analyst, Scrum Master, or similar role supporting IT systems or software development projects.
* Must have experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business, functional, and system requirements.
* Must have experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, requirements documentation, and related project artifacts.
* Must have experience creating, executing, and maintaining functional test cases and test scripts.
* Must have experience supporting functional testing, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and defect validation.
* Must have experience documenting defects, tracking issues, and coordinating with developers, testers, and business stakeholders to support resolution.
* Must have hands\-on experience using Jira to manage user stories, tasks, defects, sprint activities, and project progress.
* Must have experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and supporting Scrum ceremonies.
* Must have experience preparing project documentation, requirements traceability matrices, test documentation, user guides, standard operating procedures, status updates, or similar documentation.
* Must have strong written and verbal communication, analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.


##### **Preferences**


* Experience supporting business analysis, functional testing, Agile delivery, or software/system implementation projects is preferred.
* Scrum Master certification, Agile certification, or related project management certification is preferred.
* Experience supporting federal government IT projects is preferred.
* Experience with requirements traceability and mapping requirements to test cases is preferred.
* Experience supporting Oracle, ERP, financial systems, case management systems, or other enterprise applications is preferred.
* Experience with test management tools, automated testing tools, defect tracking tools, Confluence, SharePoint, Visio, ServiceNow, or Azure DevOps is preferred.
* Experience developing dashboards, reports, metrics, business process flows, workflow diagrams, or system process documentation is preferred.


##### **Benefits**


* Medical, Dental, Vision Benefits
* Paid Life
* Paid Vacation, Holidays, Sick Leave, Floating Holidays, Bereavement Leave
* Semi\-monthly pay cycle


##### **Work With Us**


Cardinal Technology Systems, Corp (“CTech\-Sys”), www.ctech\-sys.com, is an SBA Certified 8(a) and HUBZone company located in the National Capital Region (NCR) and serves both government and commercial clients such clients as US CBP, US CIS, DLA, DFuse Technologies, and American Environmental Engineering Consultants.


Cardinal Technology Systems, Corp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and it's our policy to consider applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, alienage, ancestry, or any other factors prohibited by law. Employment selections are based on company and client requirements and the qualifications and skills of the candidate. jobs.title: Intake Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Metabolic Psychiatry Labs**

Metabolic Psychiatry Labs (MPL) is pioneering a new approach to mental health by targeting its metabolic roots. We provide specialized psychiatric care to patients with Serious Mental Illness, integrating evidence\-based psychiatric treatment with metabolic medicine — including ketogenic dietary therapies, metabolic biomarker analysis, and digital interventions — for conditions such as depression, bipolar disorder, treatment\-resistant psychosis, and obesity.

Our treatment model is grounded in emerging evidence connecting metabolic dysfunction to psychiatric disease and was developed out of Stanford. We apply structured interventions — nutritional, pharmacologic, and behavioral — within a longitudinal care framework, and we are building a patient\- and provider\-facing application to bring these therapies directly to those who need them most.

**Position Overview**

As our Intake Coordinator, you'll be the first point of contact for callers and visitors — often the very first impression someone has of our company. You'll manage inbound calls, gather and enter intake information accurately, and route people to the right next step. This is a high\-visibility, high\-trust role at a small company: you'll wear multiple hats, help shape our intake process from the ground up, and work closely with leadership as we scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Answer and triage a high volume of inbound phone calls in a professional, friendly, and calm manner
* Collect and accurately enter caller/client information into our intake system or CRM
* Ask structured qualifying questions to determine needs and route calls/leads appropriately
* Schedule appointments, consultations, or follow\-ups as needed
* Communicate clearly with callers about next steps, timelines, and what to expect
* Maintain organized, up\-to\-date records of all intake interactions
* Flag urgent or sensitive calls for immediate escalation
* Identify gaps or inefficiencies in the intake process and suggest improvements
* Support administrative tasks (email correspondence, data cleanup, follow\-up reminders)
* Collaborate with sales, operations, or clinical/service teams (as applicable) to ensure smooth handoffs

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience at an early\-stage startup or small business
* Familiarity with CRM or intake software (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, or industry\-specific tools)
* Bilingual or multilingual abilities
* Prior experience in healthcare
* **Working Style**
* Adaptable problem solver who proactively finds solutions to improve clinical efficiency
* Self\-directed and organized: able to manage a longitudinal patient panel and asynchronous communication in a fully remote setting
* Comfortable operating in an early\-stage, evolving organization with ambiguity where processes are still being built
* You care about doing this work well and contributing to something larger than a typical clinical job

**Compensation**

* $15\-17/ hr

Pay: $15\.00 \- $17\.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**OptioRx**

OptioRx is a dynamic premier national compounding pharmacy providing best in class patient care. We serve 50 states and are committed to fostering a team environment rooted in trust, innovation, efficiency, accountability, integrity, and energy.

**Position Summary**

The Sales Representative is responsible for generating qualified leads, conducting outbound prospecting, and supporting early\-stage customer engagement for OptioRx sales initiatives. This role follows established playbooks, uses CRM tools accurately, communicates company offerings clearly, and helps build foundational customer relationships that support pipeline growth.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

* Conduct cold calls, emails, and other outbound prospecting activities in accordance with established sales processes and outreach standards.
* Identify and qualify prospective customers by asking basic discovery questions, documenting needs, and determining appropriate next steps.
* Communicate OptioRx products, services, and value propositions clearly and professionally to prospects and customers.
* Maintain accurate and timely CRM records, including outreach activity, contact information, prospect status, notes, and follow\-up tasks.
* Handle straightforward customer interactions, qualifying questions, objections, and routine informational requests using approved scripts, playbooks, and resources.
* Support departmental outreach goals by completing assigned calls, emails, follow\-ups, appointments, and lead\-generation activities.
* Escalate complex customer questions, non\-standard requests, or higher\-value opportunities to more experienced sales team members or leadership.
* Participate in sales training, team meetings, coaching sessions, and campaign activities to strengthen product knowledge, prospecting skills, and sales effectiveness.
* Collaborate with teammates by sharing prospect information, customer insights, and market feedback that may improve sales outreach or pipeline development.
* Demonstrate professionalism, resilience, persistence, and strong customer service while representing OptioRx in prospect and customer interactions.
* Schedule introductory meetings, follow\-up calls, or handoffs with more experienced sales team members when prospects demonstrate potential interest.
* Maintain consistent follow\-up with assigned leads using approved outreach cadences, scripts, and communication templates.
* Support lead nurturing by sending approved materials, documenting prospect responses, and tracking next steps in the CRM.
* Assist with basic research on prospective customers, target accounts, and contact information to support outreach preparation.
* Provide timely updates to sales leadership or senior sales team members regarding prospect activity, barriers, and potential opportunities.
* Support newly identified account opportunities by organizing initial notes, contact details, and customer needs for transition to the appropriate sales owner.

NON\-ESSENTIAL DUTIES

* Assist with sales campaigns, market research, CRM cleanup, customer lists, and outreach projects as requested.
* Support onboarding or cross\-training activities by sharing basic process knowledge once proficient in assigned responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

* 0–1 years sales experience; high school diploma required, bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Basic understanding of customer service, outbound communication, lead generation, objection handling, and time management.
* Ability to learn company products, services, value propositions, target customer profiles, sales terminology, CRM systems, and prospecting techniques.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with prospects, customers, and internal teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate CRM documentation with minimal errors.
* Ability to follow established priorities, workflows, scripts, and standard operating procedures while receiving frequent coaching and feedback.
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods, use a computer and phone, and perform routine office\-based work.
* Ability to conduct basic prospect research and prepare for outreach using available tools and approved resources.
* Comfortable making high\-volume outbound calls and sending professional follow\-up communications.
* Ability to recognize when a prospect requires escalation to a more experienced sales team member.
* Willingness to learn sales processes, product knowledge, customer profiles, and CRM expectations through coaching and training.

CORE COMPETENCIES

* Prospecting Discipline: Consistently completes targeted outreach activities, follows established sales processes, and maintains focus on generating qualified opportunities.
* Customer Service: Communicates professionally, responds to customer and prospect needs appropriately, and represents OptioRx with a service\-oriented approach.
* CRM Accuracy: Maintains complete, timely, and accurate records of outreach activity, prospect information, notes, and follow\-up tasks.
* Communication: Clearly conveys information through verbal and written interactions while adapting messaging to prospects, customers, and internal team members.
* Time Management: Organizes daily priorities, completes assigned outreach and follow\-up activities, and manages work efficiently within established expectations.
* Resilience and Persistence: Maintains professionalism and motivation through rejection, objections, and repeated outreach while continuing to pursue sales goals.
* Coachability: Receives feedback, applies direction, and continues developing foundational sales skills.
* Attention to Detail: Captures accurate prospect information, next steps, and activity notes to support effective handoffs and follow\-up.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

* Revenue
* Product mix
* Daily activity, including phone calls in prospecting, sales cycle 1, and sales cycle 2
* New accounts added

jobs.title: Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
**THE COMPANY**
Invio Automation is a leader in Industry 4\.0, delivering high\-value automation solutions that help customers accelerate growth in specialized markets such as medical devices, life sciences, and advanced manufacturing. With deep domain expertise and extensive engineering capabilities, Invio partners with clients from early\-stage product design and R\&D through to full\-scale automation. Invio operates through two integrated segments:
* The **Solutions Segment** delivers engineered systems for precision manufacturing, including robotic cells, multi\-station assembly lines, and other automation solutions.
* The **Technologies Segment** focuses on advanced autonomous systems and ergonomic tooling, including heavyweight Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), turnkey assembly solutions, and custom lift\-assist tools for safety\-critical applications.

* Utilize existing personal industry relationships to accelerate sales efforts and expand Invio Automation’s customer base.
* Drive sales of Autonomous Guided Vehicles (AGVs) and Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) by leveraging a proven track record in automation and robotics sales.
* Collaborate with customers to define project scopes and support the development of strong business cases.

* Position Invio Automation as a preferred partner for advanced material handling solutions in general assembly environments, while actively identifying and developing new business opportunities.
* Expand the portfolio of solutions sold to key accounts, showcasing Invio’s full capabilities—including AGVs, door carriers, vision systems, robotic cells, and sub\-assembly lines.
* Maintain a consistent, in\-person presence at major production facilities, especially in preparation for upcoming vehicle launches.
* Work cross\-functionally with engineering and technical teams to craft innovative, cost\-effective solutions tailored to customer needs.
* Support marketing efforts by contributing to the creation of high\-impact presentations, videos, and digital content aimed at automotive OEMs.
* Partner with the services team to ensure long\-term customer success through proactive service and support offerings.
* Maintain a strong focus on sales performance metrics and KPIs to drive continued growth and accountability.

**Qualifications:**
* To perform this job successfully, an individual must be professional, proactive, and positive. Having a passion for exceptional customer service and support is a must. Being sensitive to the unpredictable demands and uncertainties associated with human resources is a requisite to delivering superior results and exceeding the expectations of our internal and external customers.

**Other Skills and Abilities:**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, problem\-solving, and conflict\-resolution skills
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software
* Proficiency with or the ability to quickly learn the organization’s ERP, and Salesforce system
* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate business objectives into Invio’s sales initiatives
* Willingness to travel within North America, up to 50% of the time

**EDUCATION**
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Sales, Business, Mechanical Engineering or related field required.

**INVIO AUTOMATION’S CORE VALUES**
* We take pride in the reliability of our team and the difficult problems we solve for customers.
* We deliver real customer value that positively impacts the lives of those around us.
* We are dependable. Relationships and trust matter.
* Our ingenuity and desire to improve lives will complement our suite of solutions.
* We strive to demonstrate that our attention to detail does not start or end with the solutions we engineer and deliver.

jobs.title: Patient Engagement Specialist
jobs.description:
**Before you apply, please read this carefully.**  

This is a quota\-driven, high\-volume outbound calling role. You will make 120\+ calls per day to patients eligible for Chronic Care Management programs, working toward weekly and monthly enrollment targets. The work is structured, fast\-paced, and numbers\-driven — closer to a sales or call center environment than a traditional healthcare role. If you thrive on clear goals, enjoy persuasive conversations, and are energized by hitting targets, this role is a strong fit. **What You Will Actually Do Day\-to\-Day:****This role is built around high\-volume outbound patient outreach and enrollment. Here is a realistic picture of a typical day:*** 120\+ outbound calls per day: You will work through a structured patient list, reaching out to individuals eligible for Chronic Care Management (CCM) to explain the program and enroll them.
* Persuasive, patient\-centered conversations: Your job is to clearly communicate the value of CCM, address hesitations, and guide patients to a yes — using an approach that is warm and informative, not pushy.
* Inbound call handling: You will also field inbound calls from patients with questions or concerns, handling them professionally and efficiently.
* Quota management: Weekly and monthly enrollment targets are set and tracked. Your performance is measured against these goals consistently.
* Intake coordination: For newly enrolled patients, you will conduct or support intake assessments and hand off to the Care Coordination team.
* Annual satisfaction outreach: You will conduct patient satisfaction calls for all practices on an annual cycle.

 **Who Thrives in This Role:****This role is a strong fit for candidates who have worked in environments like:*** Outbound call centers — healthcare, insurance, or benefits enrollment.
* Inside sales or phone\-based sales roles.
* Patient access, scheduling, or pre\-authorization roles with high call volume.
* Health plan outreach or member engagement programs.

 **You will do well here if you:*** Are energized by talking to people all day and naturally build rapport quickly over the phone.
* Stay motivated by targets and take ownership of your numbers.
* Can handle rejection gracefully and stay consistent call after call.
* Communicate clearly and adapt your approach to different patients.
* Are bilingual (English/Spanish) — bilingual candidates are strongly preferred.

 **Performance Expectations:*** Performance is measured by enrollment volume against weekly and monthly production quotas. Targets will be shared during onboarding.
* Consistently meeting or exceeding these targets is a core requirement of the role — not an aspiration.
* Call volume: 120\+ outbound calls per day is the baseline expectation.
* Enrollment targets: Weekly and monthly quotas are tracked and reviewed with your manager.
* Sustained underperformance may result in a performance improvement plan or, if unresolved, separation from the role.

 **Required Qualifications:*** Minimum 1 year of call center experience — healthcare setting strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding goals in a call center or phone\-based sales environment.
* Strong, clear, and engaging phone presence — you will be on the phone all day.
* Self\-directed and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
* Must reside and work in the continental US.
* CMA certification preferred but not required.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) strongly preferred.
* Experience with EHR or CRM platforms a plus.

 **Home Workspace Requirements — Please Confirm Before Applying:****This is a HIPAA\-regulated, phone\-based role. Your home workspace must meet these standards from day one:*** **Private, quiet workspace:** Free from pets, children, and background noise during all work hours.
* Wired internet connection: High\-speed, wired (not Wi\-Fi) internet capable of supporting VoIP calls is required. Please verify your setup before applying — this requirement cannot be waived.
* HIPAA\-compliant environment: No visible PHI, no shared working space during patient calls.
* Wellbox provides: laptop, headset, and all necessary software. You provide: the workspace and wired internet connection.

  

Please do not apply if your current home setup does not meet the wired internet requirement. **Schedule:*** Full\-time: 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday
* Hours: Generally 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM; may vary slightly based on client needs
* This is a structured\-hours role. Availability during core hours is required.

 **Compensation:*** *$18 hourly.*
* *Benefits include medical, dental, vision, life.*
* *PTO, paid holidays, and 401k match.*

 **Still here? Great.**
If 120 calls a day sounds energizing rather than exhausting, and you are driven by knowing exactly how you are performing against a goal, we would love to talk. Every call you make is a chance to connect a patient with care they may not have known was available to them.  

This position is contingent upon completion of a satisfactory background check.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

*The ideal candidate for this role must be able to work during Eastern Time business hours (Monday \- Friday 8:30 am \- 5:30 pm ET)*

***A bit about this role:***
============================

  

Our Member Experience and Engagement (MXE) team designs the service experience that makes members trust and love Devoted — letters, SMS, calls, MyDevoted, chat, push. Our campaigns reach hundreds of thousands of older adults at moments that matter: a missed screening, a new diagnosis, a prescription that never got picked up.


As the Member Engagement Operations Associate, you'll be the reason those campaigns go out right. Working closely with our Member Engagement Operations Manager, you'll prep tickets, build audiences, run QA, keep documentation clean, monitor responses, and pull the numbers that tell us whether it worked. A meaningful share of this work supports Devoted Medical, our clinical arm: D2Me visits, clinical program activation, closing care gaps. When a campaign lands well, a member gets care they were going to miss.

  

You're the person who catches the missing comma, the wrong date, and the audience list that looks a little off. You pick up new tools fast and stay organized when a lot is in flight.

 **Two things about how we work:**

* **We test instead of assuming**. You'll build test and control arms and keep variants straight. A holdout handled carelessly turns a real answer into no answer at all.
* **Your manager sets the QA standard; you run it.** We expect you to tell us when a check is wrong, missing something, or could be automated. Spot a step that should be a template, a check that could be automated, or a doc three people maintain separately? We want to hear it. **Curiosity about AI and automation is important here.**

***Responsibilities and Impact will include:***
===============================================

### **Building and launching campaigns**

* Build, test, launch, and measure campaigns across SMS, email, print, outbound calls, MyDevoted, and chat with data analysts, member service guides, clinical partners, and product/tech
* Build audiences and configurations to spec, including test and control arms, with clean variant tracking
* Deliver against precise SOPs, timelines, and checklists, and keep every campaign compliant

### **Quality and contact hygiene**

* Run pre\- and post\-launch QA: audience verification, business rules, volume confirmation, SME review
* Apply suppression rules and check contact history, so a member who already heard from us this week doesn't get three more messages
* Flag checks that are wrong, missing, or automatable — improve the standard, don't just execute it
* Monitor responses after launch and escalate anything that looks wrong, fast

### **Keeping the system honest**

* Keep ticket documentation, status, and ownership current in Monday.com
* Support the refresh cycle for automated campaigns so content and logic don't go stale
* Maintain and tag our campaign inventory: what exists, what's reusable, what's a one\-off
* Get documentation to the member service and outreach teams running new campaigns

### **Measuring and reporting**

* Track and report campaign performance, including test versus control results
* Pull and check the numbers behind readouts
* Build and maintain the templates, checklists, and SOPs that make the process faster

***Required skills and experience:***
=====================================

* 1\-3 years in communications, digital strategy, engagement projects, or consulting — or a recent college/grad grad with internship experience or demonstrated ability
* Meticulous attention to detail and real care about getting things right
* Some experience using data and analytics tools to make decisions
* Quick to learn new tools and systems
* Able to simplify and clearly explain complex information
* Independent, collaborative, and communicative in a dynamic startup environment
* Able to work East Coast hours (\~8:30am–5:30pm ET)

***Desired Skills and experience:***
====================================

* Professional fluency in Spanish, written and spoken, including judgment on cultural relevancy and plain\-language translation quality. Preferred, not required — a meaningful share of our members read and speak Spanish
* Healthcare technology or public health experience
* Exposure to A/B testing, holdouts, or campaign measurement
* Familiarity with Monday.com, Asana, Jira, or similar
* Interest in using AI and automation to reduce manual work

***Salary:*** **$58,000 \- $82,680 / annually**
===============================================

Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. jobs.title: Manager, Workforce Management
jobs.description:
Overview:

HealthEdge® offers AI\-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.**Role Summary**


The Manager, Workforce Management Scheduling leads a team of WFM Scheduling Analysts supporting both Contact Center and Back Office operations. This role owns schedule publication, real\-time and intraday management, back office inventory and workload management across both environments, and is the primary escalation point for scheduling issues and staffing exceptions.

**What You'll Own**

**Leadership \& Team Management**

* Lead and develop a team of WFM Analysts supporting both Contact Center and Back Office operations, providing day\-to\-day coaching, performance management and professional development
* Serve as the primary escalation point for scheduling issues, intraday staffing exceptions and real\-time monitoring gaps across all functions
* Foster a team culture grounded in operational accountability, data\-driven decision making and strong partnership with the operational leaders they support
* Onboard and train new WFM analysts, ensuring consistency in scheduling methodologies, tool usage and reporting standards across the team

**Scheduling Operations**

* Oversee the production and publication of schedules across Contact Center and Back Office functions, ensuring coverage requirements, service level goals and turnaround time (TAT) commitments are met
* Ensure scheduling frameworks account for function\-specific requirements, including multi\-skill and multi\-channel complexity for Contact Center and work type, complexity tier and regulatory TAT requirements for Back Office
* Maintain and enforce scheduling policies and standards, including shift bid processes, time\-off management, exception handling and schedule change procedures
* Partner with the Director of Resource Planning to ensure staffing requirement outputs are accurately translated into executable schedules across all teams

**Real\-Time Monitoring \& Intraday Management**

* Oversee real\-time monitoring operations across Contact Center queues and Back Office work queues, ensuring analysts are identifying and responding to intraday staffing variances promptly
* Establish escalation protocols and intraday response playbooks that guide analysts in making consistent, well\-reasoned adjustments when volume or staffing conditions deviate from plan
* Review intraday performance trends regularly, partnering with operational supervisors to address adherence issues, unexpected volume spikes or staffing shortfalls before they impact service levels or TAT commitments
* Ensure real\-time monitoring standards and tools are consistently applied across both Contact Center and Back Office environments

**Back Office Inventory \& Workload Management**

* Oversee daily and weekly work distribution and queue management processes for Back Office functions, ensuring inventory is assigned to the right staff at the right time based on skills, complexity and regulatory deadlines
* Monitor inventory aging and TAT compliance across Claims, Utilization Management and other back\-office functions, escalating risks to operational leaders before SLA or regulatory thresholds are breached
* Partner with Back Office operational managers to adjust work assignment strategies in response to unexpected volume shifts, staff shortages or audit and compliance\-driven prioritization needs

**Reporting** **\& Performance Management**

* Establish a consistent reporting cadence for scheduling effectiveness, adherence, real\-time performance and inventory health across both Contact Center and Back Office functions
* Review and validate analyst\-produced reports and dashboards before distribution to operational leaders, ensuring accuracy, clarity and actionable insights
* Track and report on key WFM metrics including schedule adherence, occupancy, shrinkage, TAT compliance and inventory aging, identifying trends that require process or scheduling adjustments
* Conduct regular one\-on\-ones and team performance reviews, using WFM metric outcomes to inform coaching priorities and development goals for analysts

**Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Continuous Improvement**

* Serve as the primary WFM Scheduling liaison to Contact Center and Back Office operational leaders, building trusted relationships and ensuring scheduling decisions are made with full operational context
* Collaborate closely with the Resource Planning team to ensure smooth handoffs between capacity plans and scheduling execution, flagging gaps or misalignments early
* Continuously evaluate scheduling processes, tools and workflows, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort and strengthen scheduling outcomes across both environments
* Support the evaluation and implementation of WFM platform enhancements, serving as a key stakeholder in tool configuration, testing and rollout activities

**Leadership Competencies**

**Integrity \&** **Trust** — the threshold expectation for every role at HealthEdge, above and ahead of the competency framework.

**Core competencies for this role:**

* Lead \& Inspire
* Develop Self \& Others

**What You Bring**

* 5\+ years of progressive experience in workforce management, scheduling or real\-time analysis, including experience across contact center and back office / operations environments
* 2\+ years of experience directly managing a team of WFM analysts or schedulers
* Hands\-on experience with WFM scheduling and real\-time monitoring platforms (e.g., Verint, NICE, Genesys) as well as back\-off

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Industrial and Institutional
jobs.description:
**KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER \- I\&I (INDUSTRIAL AND INSTITUTIONAL)**
Role Summary
The Key Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing strategic key customer relationships in the Industrial and Institutional (I\&I) market. This position owns the account strategy for assigned key accounts, including profitable growth, contract and pricing execution, opportunity pipeline development, forecasting, and customer satisfaction. Targeted growth will be achieved through strong relationships with Procurement, R\&D, Senior Management, Product Management, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Quality, Regulatory, and other key customers and internal stakeholders. The candidate will serve as a market\-facing commercial leader for I\&I strategic accounts while representing account priorities, customer needs, and market insights to management and leadership. This role is expected to demonstrate leadership capability through cross\-functional influence, customer strategy ownership, sound commercial judgment, and the ability to translate customer priorities into aligned commercial and cross\-functional action.
Key Responsibilities
* Responsible for profitable sales growth, account retention, and strategic relationship development within assigned North American I\&I key accounts.
* Build and maintain strong, long\-lasting relationships with key accounts.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans to achieve revenue, volume, margin, and pipeline growth targets.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities, product conversions, specification approvals, and share\-gain opportunities within existing strategic accounts.
* Develop account\-specific sales strategies and account plans while providing regular industry updates, customer insights, competitive intelligence, pricing feedback, service updates, and volume forecasts for defined strategic accounts.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to develop and implement account\-specific strategies, including commercial, technical, supply chain, quality, regulatory, and customer service action plans.
* Coordinate new product development opportunities via the UPP process to support growth.
* Ability to call on and develop networks at all levels within an account, including senior leadership, procurement, technical, marketing, manufacturing, quality, regulatory, and supply chain stakeholders. Demonstrates advanced network development skills by identifying and engaging champions, users, influencers, and decision\-makers, and by bringing in other Pilot functions to support selling efforts.
* Analyze I\&I market trends, customer formulation needs, competitive activity, supply dynamics, and pricing movements to identify opportunities, risks, and threats.
* Meets administrative requirements including:
	+ Meeting call reports are timely and contain a balance of commercial, technical and operations inputs (market feedback on customers, industry trends, pricing, and competitors).
	+ Ensure significant business is supported by appropriate contracts, letters of agreement, pricing documentation, or other commercial commitments when in the best interest of Pilot Chemical.
	+ Forecasting and budgeting of individual accounts and support of overall budgeting for segment.
	+ Manages travel budget.
	+ Prepare periodic account reviews and sales reports showing sales volume, revenue, margin, opportunity pipeline, forecast accuracy, risks, and areas of proposed account expansion.

Required Competencies
* BS/BA degree required. Minimum of 10 years of commercial experience in specialty chemicals or related markets, preferably with experience serving Industrial and Institutional customers. Prior key account management experience preferred.
* Knowledge of surfactants, antimicrobial actives, specialty chemistries, and their applications in I\&I cleaning, sanitation, laundry, ware wash, hard surface cleaning, industrial cleaning, and janitorial/sanitation markets preferred.
* A ‘market\-facing’ mentality / orientation.
* Growth mindset with a proven record of new business acquisition, account penetration, and expansion of existing customer relationships.
* Ability to understand operational and commercial elements of the business and use that understanding to manage outcomes, improve customer service levels, support profitable growth, and align internal resources with account priorities.
* Strong personal computer skills including Microsoft Office suite: Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Proficient in the use of Salesforce.
* Excellent and succinct verbal, written, listening, and communication skills.
* Team player with strong interpersonal relationship skills.
* Demonstrated leadership qualities, including the ability to influence without direct authority, lead cross\-functional initiatives, and model strong commercial judgment and ownership.

Preferred Competencies
* Technical degree

*Join our growing team!*
