jobs.title: Learning & Development Consultant
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Learning \& Development Consultant  
**Contract Type:** 1099 Independent Contractor  
**Hours:** Part\-time, varying according to engagement demand  
**Location:** Remote  
**Rate:** $70\.00 per hour  
**Start Date:** Immediate upon selection  
**Engagement:** Through March 31, 2027

**Role Overview**

CTM Unlimited is seeking a Learning \& Development Consultant to support two active enterprise AI enablement programmes.

This is a hands\-on consulting role supporting a multi\-workstream engagement spanning learning, enablement, change management and communications across a large, complex organisation. The programmes are expanding to cover new AI use cases and tools, including Adobe Firefly across a broad Creative Cloud user base.

The successful candidate will lead the design, development and delivery of training and enablement assets across both programmes.

This is not a traditional curriculum design role. We are looking for someone who can move quickly, work across multiple tools and audiences, and create practical enablement content that helps people confidently adopt new technology.

**Key Responsibilities**

Learning \& Development and Content

* Design and produce role\-based training guides, walkthroughs and how\-to resources tailored to different personas and use cases.
* Develop and maintain the enablement asset library across both enterprise AI programmes.
* Create use\-case\-specific learning materials and Adobe Firefly rollout content for a broad Creative Cloud user base.
* Refresh and update existing training content as new AI capabilities and tools are introduced.
* Ensure learning assets are clear, current, practical and easy for users to apply independently.

**AI Tool Rollout and Enablement**

* Design and execute enablement for the Adobe Firefly rollout across a broad Creative Cloud user base.
* Develop distinct messaging and learning paths for GenAI channel users and the wider creative population.
* Establish and manage post\-launch support mechanisms such as office hours, Q\&A forums and other adoption support.
* Sequence enablement activities across concurrent AI rollouts while taking change saturation into consideration.
* Work closely with the wider programme team to ensure training and enablement align with technical rollout schedules.

Leadership and Stakeholder Enablement

* Facilitate leadership alignment sessions focused on programme direction and priorities.
* Prepare and facilitate sessions with senior stakeholders, including navigating ambiguity and evolving programme priorities.
* Support champion networks with targeted enablement content and readiness materials.
* Work across different stakeholder groups and tailor learning approaches to their needs.

Adoption Tracking and Reporting

* Track adoption and usage across programme tools and the Adobe Firefly rollout.
* Report adoption progress to programme leadership.
* Translate adoption and usage data into clear insights and recommendations.
* Monitor adoption health and recommend adjustments to the enablement approach where required.

Programme Coordination

* Maintain the Coda workspace for enablement\-related trackers, pages and views.
* Compile and distribute weekly status reports for the L\&D and enablement workstreams.
* Maintain action items and decision logs.
* Support coordination across both programme workstreams.

What You Will Own

* Enablement asset design and format
* Training delivery sequencing and scheduling
* Adoption tracking approach and reporting cadence
* Office hours and post\-launch support model

What You Will Recommend

* Prioritisation when rollout timelines become compressed
* Escalation of adoption risks to the Engagement Partner
* Cross\-programme L\&D coordination across both workstreams

What You Will Collaborate On

* Messaging tone and content with the Change \& Communications Lead
* Persona definition and use\-case mapping with the wider programme team
* Client\-facing asset standards with the Engagement Partner

What This Role Is Not

* This is not a generalist Change Management role. The focus is on learning, enablement and training rather than the broader change strategy.
* This is not a content\-only role. You will be responsible for understanding whether the content you create is actually driving adoption.
* This is not a passive order\-taking role. You will be expected to use your professional judgement, challenge unrealistic timelines and identify when content is or is not ready for an audience.
* This is not a Project Manager role. Some coordination is required, but the primary responsibility is making enablement happen.
* This is not a full\-time embedded position. This is a part\-time independent contractor engagement requiring the ability to manage your own schedule.

Required Qualifications

* **5\+ years of experience** in Learning \& Development, Instructional Design or Enablement Consulting.
* Demonstrated experience creating learning and enablement content that successfully reaches users in complex organisations.
* Proven experience delivering **technology enablement programmes**, ideally involving enterprise software rollouts, digital transformation or AI/GenAI adoption.
* Experience working with multiple stakeholder personas and creating tailored learning experiences for different audiences.
* Comfortable facilitating sessions with senior leaders and supporting direction\-setting conversations.
* Strong written and visual communication skills, with the ability to produce polished, professional learning assets.
* Experience measuring adoption and translating usage data into meaningful insights and recommendations.
* Experience working within a consulting or advisory environment.
* Ability to work independently with limited infrastructure and oversight.
* Comfortable using AI tools such as **ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot or Gemini** as part of your regular workflow.
* Previous 1099 independent contractor experience is preferred.

jobs.description:
Harbor is looking for a full\-time, temporary, Learning \& Development Specialist (Go To Market) for a 5–6\-month engagement. The Learning \& Development Specialist (Go To Market) is a contract role responsible for designing and developing high\-quality learning solutions that build critical sales enablement capabilities across Harbor's Client Engagement / Delivery organizations. Working closely with Delivery leaders, subject matter experts, and Learning \& Development, this role will translate business priorities, capability needs, and subject matter expertise into practical, engaging, and scalable learning experiences.



This is a hands\-on individual contributor role responsible for designing, developing, and implementing learning solutions in support of GTM priorities. The Specialist will independently drive assigned learning workstreams from needs assessment and design through development and implementation, working directly with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand learning gaps and translate them into effective learning solutions.



The role requires strong instructional design and content development expertise, project management capabilities, excellent communication skills, and an understanding of how professionals learn and operate within a fast\-paced professional services or consulting environment. The role will work within established GTM priorities and program direction, partnering closely with Learning \& Development to ensure learning solutions align with Harbor's overall learning approach and standards, onboarding experience, brand, UGE, and broader learning ecosystem.



#### **Key Responsibilities:**


**Instructional Design \& Content Development:**


* Partner with GTM leaders and subject matter experts to identify learning needs and translate business priorities, knowledge gaps, and complex subject matter into clear learning objectives and effective learning solutions.
* Design and develop practical, engaging learning experiences across multiple modalities, including instructor\-led and virtual learning, digital learning, presentations, toolkits, job aids, practice activities, assessments, and reinforcement resources.
* Apply adult learning and instructional design principles to recommend appropriate learning approaches, modalities, sequencing, and reinforcement within established program priorities.
* Curate and adapt existing internal and external content where appropriate to accelerate development and create cohesive learning experiences.
* Develop facilitator guides, participant materials, exercises, case studies, knowledge checks, and other resources to support effective delivery and application.
* Ensure learning materials are polished, consistent, accessible, and aligned with Harbor's learning and brand standards.


 **Learning Project Management:**


* Independently manage assigned learning projects from initial discovery through development, launch, and evaluation.
* Develop and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and stakeholder responsibilities.
* Coordinate content development and review cycles across Delivery leaders/subject matter experts, Client Engagement, L\&D, and other stakeholders.
* Manage multiple concurrent learning initiatives while maintaining quality and meeting agreed\-upon timelines.
* Proactively identify risks, dependencies, scope considerations, and potential barriers and recommend solutions to keep projects moving forward.
* Facilitate effective project meetings, design sessions, content reviews, and stakeholder discussions.


**Stakeholder Management \& Business Partnership:**


* Build effective working relationships with GTM leaders, subject matter experts, Learning \& Development, and cross\-functional partners.
* Lead discovery conversations with stakeholders and SMEs to understand business context, target audiences, performance gaps, and learning needs.
* Apply instructional design expertise to recommend effective learning solutions within established GTM priorities and program direction.
* Synthesize stakeholder and SME input into clear learning requirements, content, and deliverables.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders at varying levels of the organization, including senior leaders, and proactively manage feedback, decisions, and next steps.
* Demonstrate strong business acumen and an understanding of the pace, client orientation, and performance expectations of a professional services environment.
* Partner with external learning/content providers as needed, coordinating inputs, reviews, and deliverables and ensuring resulting content meets defined business and learning requirements.


**Learning Technology \& Implementation:**


* Develop and maintain digital learning content using tools such as Articulate 360\.
* Support the implementation and launch of learning experiences through Workday Learning, including course setup, testing, learner journeys, materials, and launch readiness as appropriate.
* Conduct quality assurance and testing to ensure learning content and experiences function as intended.
* Leverage learning technology and AI\-enabled tools, where appropriate, to increase the efficiency and scalability of content development.


**Measurement \& Continuous Improvement:**


* Define appropriate measures of learning effectiveness based on learning objectives and desired business outcomes.
* Develop assessments, knowledge checks, surveys, and other mechanisms to evaluate learner understanding and experience.
* Review learner feedback, stakeholder input, and available learning data to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Recommend enhancements to learning content, delivery approaches, and supporting resources based on data and feedback.
* Capture lessons learned and reusable content or approaches that can support future learning initiatives.

 #### **Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience in Learning \& Develop

new_jobs.title: Strategy & Operations
new_jobs.description:
**Our Mission:** **Hospital\-Quality Care, Everywhere.**
========================================================


The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tags to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995\.


Verse Medical is building the modern software infrastructure to make it happen. We're a well\-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high\-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. We’re growing fast and looking for people who are driven by this mission to join us!

**Our Values:** **The Principles That Guide Us**
================================================


Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.

* **We are transparent, upfront and direct.** We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.
* **We value speed of iteration.** We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.
* **We give 110% effort, 30% of the time.** We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.
* **We empathize with customers to a fault.** When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, *"How can we make this better?"* We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real\-world challenges of healthcare.

**Your Impact: How You'll Help Us Heal a Broken System**
--------------------------------------------------------


This is a rare opportunity to join a small but mighty team in a broad, high\-ownership role. The S\&O team's work is both internal and externally focused. We untangle cross\-team coordination problems, design and own the operational processes that allow our company to scale, but also sometimes represent Verse externally when a partnership or deal calls for it.


You'll report to the Head of Strategy \& Operations and work closely with functional leaders across Partnerships, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and Product.

**What You'll Achieve: A Glimpse into Your Contributions**
----------------------------------------------------------


The specific initiative you're staffed on will shift over time, but your contributions will generally fall into a few recurring shapes of work:

* Cross\-functional coordination on high\-stakes, cross\-cutting initiatives: situations where multiple teams each own a piece of the puzzle and the work only succeeds if someone drives alignment and follow\-through across all of them (e.g., regulatory, compliance, or audit\-driven work)
* End\-to\-end program management for complex, high\-visibility deployments: running the project plan and owning the outcome, whether that's a major customer or partner implementation, or an initiative requiring close, sustained partnership with Engineering, Product, and Design
* Quantitative modeling and strategic analysis: building the financial or operational models that underpin major company decisions, from resourcing to strategic finance questions
* Revenue\-adjacent strategy and execution: go\-to\-market strategy in close partnership with Sales, and leading Verse's side of RFPs and similar competitive or procurement processes
* Incubating new functions from scratch: taking a "this doesn't exist yet, but we need it" problem and building the team, process, or capability that solves it, from initial design through steady\-state operation


This role comes with great responsibility \- we absolutely love what we do here at Verse and have a healthy culture, but you can expect this role and our expectations to be fairly rigorous.

**What You'll Bring: The Skills and Experience You'll Leverage**
----------------------------------------------------------------


We believe diverse backgrounds lead to better solutions. If you believe you can deliver the outcomes above, we encourage you to apply even if your path here looks different from what's listed.

### **Core Skills \& Experience**

* 4\+ years in a banking, consulting, startup, or otherwise rigorous role
* First\-principles thinking: in most cases, the work we're doing has fundamentally never been done before, at Verse or elsewhere. You should be able to construct solutions from scratch.
* Quantitative and analytical skills: all of our team members are expected to have solid numerical instincts and modeling skills
* Partnerships and sales: all of our team members should expect to carry the baton in some external relationship at some point, whether they're selling something to a customer, selecting and negotiating with vendors, or project managing a new partnership launch.
* Implementation and execution: the best team members not only produce insights, recommendations, strategies, but do whatever it takes to make sure these actually come to life. This usually requires a bias for quick action rather than slow and polished deliverables.
* Comfort with "spike" work: our workload isn't evenly paced — you flex your hours and effort to match real demand, surging when the team hits a crunch, a live issue, or a time\-sensitive push, and settling back into a sustainable pace once it passes

**The Rewards \& Reality: Compensation, Benefits \& Logistics**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Sunnyvale, CA, United States

* Administration
* JOB219134


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


Were a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


The Fluorescence Imaging Team at Intuitive is developing agents designed to work seamlessly with Intuitive’s robotic platforms and Firefly imaging technology. The agents have the potential to highlight critical anatomy and disease in real time—giving surgeons clearer information at the moment decisions matter most and helping improve outcomes for patients.


If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position**


The Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance (RAQA) Project Manager serves as a strategic project management partner to Regulatory Affairs \& Quality Assurance leadership, with integrated project management responsibility for regulatory strategy execution and quality\-assurance readiness across development programs. The role translates regulatory strategies, health authority requirements, quality\-system obligations, and technical decisions into coordinated cross\-functional plans from clinical development through marketing application submission, approval, launch readiness, and post\-approval lifecycle management.


Reporting to the Program Management \& Operations organization, the RAQA Project Manager partners closely with Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC), Clinical Development, Clinical Development \& Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Writing, Pharmacovigilance, Supply Chain, Commercial, Legal, and external partners. The position places primary emphasis on regulatory planning, submission execution, health authority engagement, regulatory commitments, and inspection and compliance readiness, while integrating associated Quality Assurance activities into unified project plans.


**Roles and Responsibilities**


* Partner with Regulatory Affairs leadership to translate global and U.S. regulatory strategies into executable plans, including submission pathways, content plans, review timelines, decision points, dependencies, and resource requirements.


* Develop, maintain, and communicate integrated regulatory project plans for assigned programs, covering investigational and marketing applications, amendments, annual reports, meeting requests and briefing packages, responses to health authority information requests, labeling activities, regulatory commitments, and post\-approval submissions.


* Drive cross\-functional planning and operational execution for New Drug Application (NDA) submissions, including integrated content plans across Modules 1 through 5, document authoring and review workflows, publishing and submission\-readiness milestones, critical\-path management, and final filing activities.


* Coordinate regulatory deliverables across Regulatory Affairs, CMC, Clinical, Nonclinical, Quality Assurance, Product Launch, and external partners, ensuring owners, due dates, dependencies, and acceptance criteria are clearly defined.


* Plan and facilitate health authority interactions by coordinating meeting strategy, supporting briefing\-package development, question\-and\-answer preparation, rehearsals, meeting logistics, minutes, commitments, and post\-meeting action tracking.


* Maintain regulatory RAID and decision logs, submission trackers, correspondence logs, commitment registers, and governance materials; proactively identify risks to submission quality, completeness, timing, approvability, or regulatory compliance and facilitate mitigation plans.


* Coordinate responses to health authority questions and requests for information by establishing response teams, timelines, review and approval pathways, source\-document traceability, and readiness checkpoints.


* Support regulatory intelligence and impact assessments by tracking relevant guidance, precedents, policy changes, and agency feedback, and translating potential impacts into program actions, decision requests, and schedule updates.


* Integrate Quality Assurance activities that support regulatory execution, including inspection readiness, audit and inspection commitments, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) tracking, deviation and change\-control dependencies, document\-control requirements, and Good Practice (GxP) compliance deliverables.


* Partner with Quality Assurance and functional leaders to coordinate inspection\-readiness plans, mock inspections, evidence\-room and document requests, subject\-matter\-expert preparation, response tracking, and remediation follow\-through.


* Facilitate RAQA governance by preparing decision\-focused materials, documenting decisions and actions, monitoring follow\-through, and escalating unresolved risks, resource constraints, and cross\-functional conflicts through appropriate governance forums.


* Develop dashboards and executive reporting that communicate submission readiness, milestone performance, critical\-path status, health authority interactions, regulatory risks, quality\-readiness indicators, commitments, and decisions required.

This role will manage roadshows and LP engagements, coordinate GP and LP availability, and lead projects that span the team. The ideal candidate brings structure to complex logistics, keeps stakeholders and priorities aligned, and ensures that commitments, deliverables, and follow\-ups move forward on time.

new_jobs.title: Key Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============



Concert Health is the leading national behavioral health medical group committed to integrating the Collaborative Care model into existing health care practices to improve patients' lives. We believe everyone, regardless of location or insurance, should have easy access to personalized, high\-quality behavioral health support that is guided by the provider they trust.


### **Who You Are**



You are a seasoned account leader who is energized by depth over breadth — you'd rather go deep on a smaller portfolio of complex, high\-value accounts than manage a wide book with less context on each. You build real fluency in each partner's clinical operations, stakeholders, and goals, and you use that fluency as the foundation for everything else: faster issue resolution, sharper growth strategy, and smoother provider onboarding.



You're equally comfortable being hands\-on and thinking several moves ahead. Day to day, you're the named point of contact partners trust to resolve issues and keep commitments on track. At the same time, you're building the data\-backed case for why a partner should expand, and running the onboarding plan for the next provider joining the account — moving between all three without losing sight of the relationship that ties them together.



You bring the judgment and track record of someone with 9\+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, or Client Services in healthcare, with a career trajectory into progressively larger and more complex accounts. You've driven measurable growth in existing accounts (not just retention), ideally onboarded new sites, providers, or users into a live account, and you're credible in a room with C\-suite and senior clinical leadership. Beyond your own accounts, other Account Managers look to you for how the job should be done — you set the standard, not just meet it.


### **Job Summary**



The Key Account Manager owns the complete lifecycle of Concert Health's most strategic partnerships — day\-to\-day relationship management, long\-term account growth, and the onboarding of new providers within existing accounts. This is Concert Health's most advanced individual\-contributor role in Account Management: one person, accountable end\-to\-end for a focused portfolio of high\-value, high\-complexity accounts, trusted to move fluidly between hands\-on servicing, strategic growth planning, and program\-managed provider launches without ever dropping the relationship thread.


**Core Responsibilities:**


*Own Day\-to\-Day Partner Success \& Issue Resolution:*


* Serve as the primary, named point of contact for a focused portfolio of key accounts, ensuring timely, high\-quality responses across clinical, operational, and administrative needs
* Proactively identify, triage, and resolve issues – driving toward systematic, scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Coordinate cross\-functional resources (clinical, operations, product, billing) to remove barriers and maintain momentum within each account
* Establish clear accountability, follow\-through, and communication loops so nothing falls through the cracks for your accounts
* Maintain deep, current fluency in each key account's clinical operations, stakeholders, and performance, so day\-to\-day servicing and long\-term strategy are always working from the same picture


*Grow Key Accounts*


* Own overall account performance for your portfolio – clinical, operational, and financial – with direct accountability for growth, not just retention
* Use utilization, outcomes, and financial data to identify white\-space opportunities within each key account and translate them into a concrete growth plan
* Build and pitch data\-backed growth and expansion cases to partner leadership, framing clinical outcomes and financial performance into a compelling case for investment
* Translate partner goals into actionable success plans with clear milestones and measurable outcomes, and hold both internal teams and partners accountable to them
* Lead negotiations with partner stakeholders to convert growth opportunities into signed, executed expansion


*Manage Leadership \& Executive Relationships*


* Build and maintain strong, trust\-based relationships with executive sponsors and senior clinical stakeholders at each key account
* Lead regular business reviews, presenting performance insights, outcomes, and growth recommendations
* Confidently navigate complex, matrixed stakeholder environments, aligning priorities and driving decision\-making
* Act as a strategic advisor, influencing partner leadership to invest in and expand Collaborative Care as a core model across their organization


*Set the Standard for the Function*


* Serve as a thought partner and mentor across the Account Management team, setting the bar for how account growth and provider onboarding should be done
* Define and codify the playbooks, frameworks, and best practices that other Account Managers are trained on
* Represent the voice of key accounts in product and clinical program roadmap discussions, with the credibility to shape how those roadmaps are prioritized
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, ownership, and urgency – anticipating challenges before they arise and acting decisively to keep accounts on track


**Qualifications:**

**Location**
------------


San Francisco; New York


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


Remote


**Department**
--------------


GTM


**Compensation**
----------------


* $300K • Offers Equity

  
**About Us:**
-------------


**AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category\-defining companies like Lovable, Ramp, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub\-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low\-latency inference, fine\-tune models, and access production\-ready sandboxes at scale.


We recently raised a $355M Series C at a $4\.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M\+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.


Our team includes creators of popular open\-source projects (e.g., Seaborn, Luig**i**), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders


**About the Role**
------------------


We're hiring the first Account Managers at Modal. You'll report to the Regional Director of Account Management and be a founding member of the team.


This function does not exist yet. There is no playbook, no territory map, no established motion. You'll own a book of business from day one and build the motion at the same time — from fast\-moving AI startups to large enterprise teams running critical infrastructure on Modal.


This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You'll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won't be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you need to hold your own in those conversations.


The profile we're hiring is a technical account manager. You've worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can credibly work with a CxO all the way down to a Developer.


**What the Role Is**
--------------------


* **A founding seat.** You're helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence you and the rest of the founding team figure out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you.
* **A technical customer\-facing role.** You'll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they're building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it's needed.
* **A book of business.** You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences.

**What the Role Is Not**
------------------------


* **A traditional post\-sales role.** You're measured on revenue, not health scores.
* **An on\-call support function.** You're not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You're driving growth.
* **A technical delivery role.** You're not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people.
* **An inherited motion.** Nothing is handed to you. If you identify gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook — you help build it.
* **A single\-lane job.** Our priorities go customer company team me. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. "this is my job".

**What You'll Achieve**
-----------------------


* Build Modal's account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business
* Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts
* Grow an account's first use case, expand into a second, and drive standardization across the Modal platform
* Get fluent enough in Modal to hold your own with engineering teams on their workloads, and know when to pull in FDEs, Support, or Product
* Work with Sales, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Support, and Product to grow accounts and feed customer signal back into the roadmap
* Travel to customers as needed to support key accounts and drive expansion opportunities

**What You'll Need to Bring**
-----------------------------


* **Customer\-facing experience.** You've owned a revenue target or supported a revenue target in a highly technical, consumption business.
* **Technical depth.** You work autonomously with Developers through CxOs and understand the core parts of the developer tech stack.
* **AI builder.** You're hands on building with AI tools — not just consuming workflows that were built for you.
* **Ownership.** You run your book of business and projects like you're the CEO of it. You're highly organized bringing stability, predictability, and pace to your work. You take action vs. waiting for direction.
* **Learning velocity.** You operate with the mindset of what I can do today vs. let me pick this up tomorrow. You move fast, take the learnings, and iterate on it.
* **Cross\-functional partner.** Low ego, easy to work with, and highly accountable. You ask for feedback, you act on it, and you'd rather be corrected early than right late. Internal teams love working with you.

-----------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

 **About the role**

  

The Customer Success team (Internally called: Technical Account Manager (TAM)) partners with our largest and most strategic accounts to understand their needs, demonstrate where Rippling can solve their business needs, and ensure retention of key accounts. TAMs own the key admin relationships and are responsible for turning customers into long\-term champions, developing account strategy, and providing enablement and optimization best practices, all while providing an impeccable customer experience along the way.

  

Leading this team will challenge your ability to context\-switch from high level customer strategy to tactical account level escalations to retention opportunities on a daily basis. The ideal candidate is a customer\-obsessed strategist, eager to build and mentor a team of incredible TAMs.

 **What you will do**

* Ruthless prioritization and time management

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.title: Creative Operations Lead, Business Marketing
new_jobs.description:
Creative \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


Business Marketing helps organizations understand and put OpenAI’s products to work. Our creative team brings that story to life across campaigns, launches, and everyday marketing experiences. We work closely with marketing partners to make ambitious, thoughtful creative work that connects with business audiences.


**About the Role**


We’re looking for a Creative Operations Lead who knows how to get exceptional creative work made at extraordinary speed and scale. Reporting to the Head of Creative, Business you will run creative resourcing, budget management, and studio operations across our internal team, contractors, and agencies; balancing ongoing campaigns with rapidly emerging launches and requests.


You’ll turn ambitious briefs and tight timelines into achievable production plans, match work to the right talent, and keep multiple teams moving without sacrificing craft or quality. JPS Products is a top\-500 Amazon seller known for licensed party supply bundles, with a growing multi\-channel footprint across Amazon, Walmart, and Shopify. We're looking for an Ecommerce Project Manager to serve as the connection between our leadership team and the contractors and virtual assistants (VAs) who execute our day\-to\-day listing, catalog, and marketplace work.

At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
  

  

For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off\-the\-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
  

  

Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.


**Job Title:** Senior Analyst, Partner Operations


**Reporting to** : Sr GTM Operations Manager

Overview


Quickbase is seeking a Senior Analyst, Partner Operations to own the operational foundation of our partner motion — the processes, data, and systems that make Quickbase predictable and easy to work with for our partners, and that make partner\-sourced pipeline accurate and trustworthy for our business.


Our partner ecosystem is a growing source of new customer acquisition, and we're investing accordingly: a new partner program plus a move to a new partner relationship management platform. This role owns the operational side of that change.

* Own partner lead lifecycle management — qualified lead definition, SLA and routing rules, duplicate and conflict handling, stage definitions, and conversion measurement
* Own the operational process behind partner incentives and rebates: qualifying criteria and revenue definitions, calculation and accrual cadence, validation against attribution data, payout workflow, and dispute resolution.

Partner Data \& Attribution

* Strong CRM fluency, ideally Salesforce; working familiarity with partner relationship management or partner portal platforms
* Experience defining cross\-functional policy — rules of engagement, territory rules, or routing logic — with senior stakeholders
* Comfortable specifying requirements against a data warehouse and BI environment (e.g., Sn
